notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/efb7570ac15c3d41beb7e9ca717fd26e942953d7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fellow Officers,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]we've just released a hotfix for the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/997010/announcements/detail/526480042764534812"][b]brand-new Self-Defense Update[/b][/url]. This update fixes many of the reported issues that we [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/516347396349756546"]laid out recently[/url]. However, as they impact console players more, we decided to release the hotfix to all platforms already instead of pushing it out in Open Beta first.[/p][p][b]Your feedback is important:[/b] Please continue to provide feedback on features, balancing, and bugs. Feel free to send us your impressions on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=http%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2Fastragon&snr=1_2108_9__2107"]Discord[/url], in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/997010/discussions/1/"]Steam Bug Forums[/url] and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwonderl.ink%2F%40policesimulator&snr=1_2108_9__2107"]on our Socials[/url].[/p][p]We're still working on additional fixes as some issues turned out be quite complex. We put the ones we're currently working on beneath the changelog.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all,[/p][p][b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changelog – Update notes.title: Thank you for playing The Self-Defense Update – Here's what happens next!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/de67e64123e71b9affaf4bc004ac31caa002d193.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fellow Officers,[/b][/p][p]a huge thank you to everyone for playing the recently released Self-Defense Update! We hope you're enjoying the new form of escalation and the heightened sense of realism and danger across the City of Brighton.[/p][p]Bringing this major update to life was a huge effort across all departments. Several prototypes were created, countless variables have been tweaked, and many discussions with age rating agencies across the globe took place, plus a full re-rating of the entire game.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/526480042764534811"][/dynamiclink]We are aware of a few issues that appeared with the release of the update. That's why, just before the weekend, we want to confirm that we are working on a first Hotfix that will resolve several problems as quickly as possible.[/p][p]We have categorized most issues into several stages of priority, with the plan to tackle the issues of utmost importance first. [/p][p][b]Here are just some of the problems we plan to fix with the first Hotfix:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Weapon Permits are always the same[/p][/*][*][p]Matrix Sign turns off when exiting vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Winch disconnects from connected vehicle when entering Patrol Car[/p][/*][*][p]Unintended circular shape across the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Locker & Garage Edits do not save reliably[/p][/*][*][p]No drug deals happening at drug deal callouts[/p][/*][*][p]Several issues related to missing options and unintended behavior after performing CPR[/p][/*][*][p]Several issues connected to Gun Usage like unjustified CP Loss[/p][/*][*][p]Lights on Patrol Cars are not as bright as before, including Unmarked[/p][/*][*][p]"Thief got away" message appearing constantly even though that isn't actually the case[/p][/*][/list][p]It's possible that not all fixes will make it into the first Hotfix, but we plan to provide additional updates [b]to address remaining issues[/b] afterwards.[/p][p]We currently estimate a release of the Hotfix in [i]Open Beta next week[/i] as we want to gather additional feedback first before releasing it to the broader public.[/p][p]Your feedback is important: Please continue to provide feedback on features, balancing, and bugs. Feel free to send us your impressions on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=http%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2Fastragon"]Discord[/url], in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/997010/discussions/2/?snr=1_2108_9__2107"]Steam Beta forums[/url] and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwonderl.ink%2F%40policesimulator"]on our Socials[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]A quick note about modding[/b][/h3][p]We've also updated the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2782949309"]modding kit for Police Simulator[/url]! They now include all information about the APV and MRV and contain multiple fixes for the FPV as well. Check out the Modding Guide for more details:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2778896763"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Make sure to follow our socials to not miss anything:[/i][/p][p][b][url="https://discord.gg/astragon" style="button" buttoncolor="#3691fa"]Discord[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@astragon_entertainment" style="button" buttoncolor="#3691fa"]TikTok[/url] [url="https://x.com/PolSimulator" style="button" buttoncolor="#3691fa"]X (Twitter)[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/policesimulator/" style="button" buttoncolor="#3691fa"]Instagram[/url] [url="https://www.facebook.com/PoliceSimulator/" style="button" buttoncolor="#3691fa"]Facebook[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Out now: The Self-Defense Update, Accident Pack, and new Uniform Packs!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/c976edafda9b6c0a9a8770694a05dbf0c24e769e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fellow Officers,[/b] [/p][p]one of the most anticipated additions has finally arrived to Police Simulator: [b]The Self-Defense Update is now available across PC, PlayStation, and Xbox![/b][/p][p]Starting today, the justified use of your gun becomes an integral part of your everyday shift as an officer of the Brighton Police Department. Throughout the Open Beta, we've also made several adjustments to further polish this feature.[/p][p]➡️ But now, let's take a closer look![/p][p][/p][h3][b]In Short: What’s included?[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/c874e0efdcd47f74864d37f15c028d6c2b5ab095.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This update is centered around introducing new NPC interactions that ultimately lead to an increase in dangerous scenarios. We've also worked on several other improvements that have been requested by the community for a while.[/p][list][*][p][b]🔫 Gun Usage by NPCs[/b][/p][list][*][p]NPCs now have a chance to draw a weapon when being confronted. They must be talked down by the officer to de-escalate the situation. This can lead to a shootout![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]🛡️ Self-Defense[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now use your Gun to protect yourself from NPCs who are wielding a weapon or attempt to shoot the officer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]🪪 New Permits[/b][/p][list][*][p]NPCs may now carry a dedicated permit allowing them to carry a gun.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]🔦 Spotlights are now Gadgets![/b][/p][list][*][p]Select spotlights as a dedicated gadget within the garage! You can now use them independently from the Matrix Sign during your shift![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]💬 Radio Chatter[/b][/p][list][*][p]More immersion during your next patrol car shift! You'll now be able to listen to a bunch of interesting messages coming in from the control center...[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]👕 New Uniform Selection[/b][/p][list][*][p]Head to the lockers to create different uniform pre-sets. You can then switch betweem easily not just at the lockers but also right from the trunk of your patrol car![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]⚠️ Accident Pack DLC[/b][/p][list][*][p]Included in the Season Pass! This DLC contains reflective clothing, an optional orange lightbar, the Multipurpose Responder Vehicle, and police vehicle skins.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]👮 Uniform Pack DLC[/b][/p][list][*][p]Not included in the Season Pass: Three absolutely iconic Uniform Packs, each containing a set of different uniforms inspired by actual police forces from the United States.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Gun Usage is here![/b][/h3][previewyoutube="yADX3XQAr1A;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]More dangerous scenarios have arrived in Police Simulator: [b]Gun Usage is finally here![/b][/p][p]With The Self-Defense Update, an NPC may now draw a weapon as they're being spawned as a particularly dangerous criminal. You are now required to de-escalate the situation. Demand them to surrender: If they comply, they will drop their weapon, lie down, and you can handcuff them.[/p][p]If not, you are not yet allowed to shoot – doing so will not end the shift but will cause the loss of CP. It can take some time for the NPC to surrender as they might verbally resist. Should the criminal choose not to surrender, they now pose an active threat. You are now allowed to shoot![/p][p]After every shot you take at them, they may either turn into an injured NPC or simply drop their weapon and surrender. If the armed criminal is injured, first aid must be administered and an ambulance must be called for further proceedings.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/5206f05a0b350edc697b17f828228239dfd3656b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Be aware: The criminal has a chance to also shoot directly at you – but doesn't have to. After a maximum of three hits, you will become critically injured and your shift will automatically end as you need to recover. Act fast and decisively to protect yourself and everyone else, Brighton needs you![/p][p]The use of your gun must always be seen as a method of last resort. After all, the officers working in the Brighton Police Department have sworn to serve all citizens – fairly, in alignment with the law, and with justice.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Even more great features![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/884742c9276a9d77dd933b8fa6f51c3020172952.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're also introducing several other great new features which you have been recommending for a while! One of them is the re-implementation of [b]spotlights[/b] – but this time, they're a proper gadget. This means, you can equip them to [i]any [/i]car and use them throughout your shift through the gadget wheel, instead of being limited to the Matrix Sign.[/p][p]We're also implementing [b]Radio Chatter[/b] that will be audible in the background of your patrol car. This way, we're providing more ambience and immersion, making the world feel much more alive.[/p][p]You're outside the precinct but still want to [b]swap your uniform[/b]? No problem – this is now possible right from the trunk of your patrol car as a handy shortcut! First, you'll need to choose a pre-set of individual uniforms at the lockers but afterwards, they're selectable in a handy fashion as a set from your trunk![/p][p]There’s also a new way to remove vehicles from the street by calling for backup, you’re now able to arrest injured NPCs before they’re taken by EMS, and other helpful changes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Out now: The Accident Pack![/b][/h3][previewyoutube="v6Yi1DRg2AI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Stay visible, stay ready – with the [b]Accident Pack[/b]! This DLC has everything you need to handle accident scenes confidently. Included are reflective clothing, an optional orange lightbar for your police car, the Multipurpose Responder Vehicle equipped with a bigger trunk for transporting more tools, and police vehicle skins that indicate you're taking care of the accident response.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3768300/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Accident_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The Accident Pack is now available as a paid DLC and is included for free in the Season Pass. If you haven't checked it out yet, we recommend doing so as it's by far the best deal if you want to be prepared for additional content we will release later this year:[/p][p][/p][h3]  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597210/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers__Season_Pass/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Fashion Patrol: Three new Uniform Packs![/b][/h3][previewyoutube="OBva47OhmHs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Bring the style of the US Police Officers to your next shift! We're introducing three absolutely iconic [b]Uniform Pack DLC[/b], each containing a set of different uniforms inspired by actual police forces from the United States.[/p][list][*][p]The [i]East Coast Police Uniform Pack[/i] contains 5 uniforms from New York City, New Hampshire, and Fairfax County. [/p][/*][*][p]The [i]South Atlantic Police Uniform Pack[/i] contains 6 uniforms from Florida, Georgia, and West Virginia.[/p][/*][*][p]The [i]Western Police Uniform Pack[/i] contains 6 uniforms from Las Vegas, Los Angeles, and Austin.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that the Uniform Packs are [b]not[/b] part of the Season Pass and must be purchased separately. However, we have created a bundle that contain all three packs at a heavily discounted price![/p][p]The Uniform Packs are now available![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58012/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_State_Uniform_Bundle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]What's next?[/b][/h3][p]The very next update is right around the corner and currently scheduled to be released in October! It will all be centered around brand-new missions – including vandalism, domestic disturbance, and more. Officers of the Brighton Police Department will expand their responsibilities around their jurisdiction![/p][p]Please look forward to more details to be shared in the coming weeks.[/p][p]In the meantime, we want to thank everyone for their support during the Open Beta of The Self-Defense Update. Please continue to report potential issues and provide your feedback – the more extensive, the better. But for now, let's take a good look at the official changelog of this update:[/p][p][/p][h3]Changelog – Update 19.0[/h3][p][b]New Features, Improvements & Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Self-Defense[/p][/*][*][p]Added Gun Usage by NPCs[/p][list][*][p]Connected to this, a new criminal state for NPCs has been added[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Spotlights as Gadgets[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the lockers to allow for the adjustment of Uniform Pre-Sets[/p][/*][*][p]Added a feature to change Uniforms from the Patrol Car Trunk[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional permits and new weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added radio chatter inside the patrol cars[/p][/*][*][p]Added Accident Pack DLC[/p][/*][*][p]Added State Uniform Pack DLCs[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes during Open Beta[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue causing liability Open Warrant to cause CP Loss if armed NPC flees first[/p][/*][*][p]Updated siren sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Player Character appearing with invisible features on Title Screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed client not being able to interact with locker after doing it once[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Wallet Thief NPC being able to enter Gun Usage sequence which blocks the callout from progressing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple interactions missing for injured armed driver NPC during Gun Usage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed NPC facing wrong direction towards player when wielding a gun[/p][/*][*][p]Integrated taser into Gun Usage[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p][i]Gameplay[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed uniform settings reverting to default after restarting and continuing shift[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Stability & Performance[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed game momentarily freezing upon entering any shift before resuming normally[/p][/*][/list][p][i]NPC & NPV[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed injured witnesses in crime scenes can not be interviewed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Medics trying to walk into slightly injured NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed injured NPCs walking towards sidewalk and then hovering back into ambulance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed arrest transport officer not entering the Police Station to retrieve arrested NPC[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed arrest transport officer not walking back to their vehicle[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Patrol Cars & Gadgets[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed blipping uses same sequence as ELS[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Graphics & Game World[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed towing animation when NPC is handcuffed while vehicle is towed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dashboard reflections in some cars during first person[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues with grass on Highway[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various visual glitches[/p][/*][/list][p][i]UI[/i][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the camera within the garage when changing Stickers to allow for a better preview[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Ninja Stars to Throwing Stars[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]Currently, the uniform is missing on your very first start in the main menu until you've selected one at the lockers. This will be fixed soon.[/p][/*][*][p]The gun permit is currently only showing the exact same entry every time you check it. This will be fixed soon.[/p][/*][*][p]Matrix Sign turns off when exiting the vehicle.[/p][/*][*][p]Winch disconnects when getting back into vehicle after previously connecting it to a different vehicle.[/p][/*][*][p]No drug deal is happening at drug deal callouts.[/p][/*][*][p]Unmarked Lights don't work in the front window.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Complete your collection to turn your trading cards into [b]Badges[/b] which you can then proudly display on your Steam Profile.[/p][p]You won't have to do much to collect your Police Simulator Trading Cards – just hop into the game and complete some shifts, and they will be yours! Trade with other players or look around the [b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/market/search?appid=753&category_753_Game%5B%5D=tag_app_997010#p1_popular_desc"]Steam Community Market[/url][/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/market/search?appid=753&category_753_Game%5B%5D=tag_app_997010#p1_popular_desc"] [/url]to complete your collection.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/62a987160193aac6cdf443a9f18bad93817b3d70.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Get rewards for crafting Badges:[/i] Unlock [b]Profile Backgrounds[/b] and [b]Emoticons[/b] themed after Police Simulator! Show your pride as an officer of the Brighton Police Department.[/p][p]Animated Avatars, Avatar Frames, Mini-Profile Backgrounds, Animated Profile Backgrounds, Animated Stickers and more are available in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/997010"][b]Steam Points Shop[/b][/url]! Use your Steam Points to add them to your profile.[/p][p]With the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/507338927350218786"]upcoming Self-Defense Update[/url], that is now available in Open Beta, there's been no better time to get back into Police Simulator! [/p][p][b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The Self-Defense Update Launches on September 17, 2025 – Open Beta starts NOW!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/2cf9de32cd76027b57f20ebf468aa2cf99bda51f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fellow Officers,[/b] [/p][p]one of the most anticipated additions to Police Simulator is coming soon: [b]Introducing The Self-Defense Update, launching September 17 across PC, PlayStation, and Xbox![/b][/p][p]This update contains:[/p][list][*][p]🔫 Gun Usage[/p][/*][*][p]🔦 Spotlights as Gadgets[/p][/*][*][p]🔊 Radio Chatter in the background[/p][/*][*][p]🔄️ Swapping Uniforms in the Trunk[/p][/*][*][p]... and more![/p][/*][/list][p]Even better: The Open Beta starts... [b]now[/b]! Let's take a closer look 👇[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How do I join the Open Beta?[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/fac4645ba5008b425eae2dd248eccaf1a296b95d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But first, let's get the most important details out of your way: You want to try out the update before it releases? No worries, it's incredibly simple to join:[/p][olist][*][p]Open [b]Steam[/b] and go to your Library [/p][/*][*][p]Right-click on [i]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/i] [/p][/*][*][p]Click [b]Properties[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]Select the [b]Betas[/b] tab [/p][/*][*][p]Choose [b]"Open_Beta"[/b] from the dropdown list [/p][/*][/olist][p]Steam will now download the update. Once complete, you’re in! Afterwards, you can download the game to try out Update 19.0![/p][p]If you encounter any issues, please share them in the [url="https://discord.gg/astragon"]#police-beta-chat channel on our Discord[/url]. You can also use our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/997010/discussions/2/"]dedicated Beta Forums[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What's included in The Self-Defense Update?[/b][/h3][p]Well, the name of the update delivers all the fun already: We're finally introducing [b]Gun Usage[/b]![/p][p]In a recent blog post, we already explained the functionality in quite some detail. If you haven't had the chance to look into it, here's a comprehensive rundown![/p][p]Right from the very beginning, we envisioned the use of a service weapon as a method of last resort. After all, the officers working in the Brighton Police Department have sworn to serve all citizens – fairly, in alignment with the law, and with justice.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/397e10d8862da3da07423b9e260d0d2e827e4ba8.gif"][/img][/p][p]Currently, the service weapon can only be used in a very narrow scope. For example, you are allowed to draw and aim it at car thieves to force them to surrender. Other scenarios usually require different means, such as the stun gun or a swift tackle. Even just aiming at a citizen with your weapon will cause the loss of Conduct Points. In any case, you’ve never been allowed to [i]shoot[/i] your weapon.[/p][p]With Update 19.0, a new level of danger arrives that actually [i]requires [/i]the use of your gun, turning it into an useful tool inside your arsenal. Yes, indeed, you’re even allowed to shoot it! The use of your hand gun comes into play once all other forms of de-escalation have been exhausted. Let's explain![/p][p]When you approach a criminal, their level of danger is constantly influenced by a randomizer. This may cause some citizens to flee, carry an illegal weapon in their inventory, or trigger other variables. Now, [i]every[/i] criminal has a chance to be spawned as a particularly dangerous criminal – leading to a handgun in their inventory and them turning into an armed criminal. The City of Brighton is becoming way more dangerous![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/0df08c9e2019e072ee635440ea891a5817a2b8dc.gif"][/img][/p][p]This can happen at any point where a criminal NPC would usually decide to flee: if the randomizer determines that they are at a high criminal level, they may draw their weapon – otherwise, they simply start fleeing. This means: A car thief, a drug dealer, even a wanted NPC can turn into someone drawing a handgun, which will require you to draw your own weapon in return! But they may also just flee, which only requires lighter measures instead.[/p][p]When an armed criminal draws a weapon, you will be notified by the game – and immediate action must be taken. The NPC will be marked with an outline, indicating the current level of threat:[/p][list][*][p][b]Yellow Outline:[/b] You're aiming at the armed criminal who has drawn their gun. You will now demand them to surrender. If they comply, they will drop their weapon, lie down, and you can handcuff them. If not, you are not yet allowed to shoot – doing so will not end the shift but will cause the loss of CP. It can take some time for the NPC to surrender as they might verbally resist.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Red Outline:[/b] The armed criminal refuses to surrender and is now an active threat. You are now allowed to shoot! The criminal has a chance to shoot at the player – but doesn't have to. After every shot you take, they may either turn into an injured NPC or drop their weapon and surrender. If the armed criminal is injured, first aid must be administered and an ambulance must be called for further proceedings.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that you can deactivate the outline in the settings![/p][p]As described, you can also be shot by the armed criminal! After a maximum of three hits, you will become critically injured and your shift will automatically end as you need to recover. Act fast and decisively to protect yourself and everyone else![/p][p]In addition, the citizens of Brighton may now carry a Concealed Weapons Permit with them. This allows a citizen to actually carry a weapon instead of the previous note that was visible on their ID.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Even more great features![/b][/h3][p]We're also introducing several other great new features which you have been recommending for a while! One of them is the re-implementation of [b]spotlights[/b] – but this time, they're a proper gadget. This means, you can equip them to [i]any [/i]car and use them throughout your shift through the gadget wheel, instead of being limited to the Matrix Sign.[/p][p]We're also implementing [b]Radio Chatter[/b] that will be audible in the background of your patrol car. This way, we're providing more ambience and immersion, making the world feel much more alive.[/p][p]You're outside the precinct but still want to [b]swap your uniform[/b]? No problem – this is now possible right from the trunk of your patrol car as a handy shortcut! First, you'll need to choose a pre-set of individual uniforms but afterwards, they're selectable as a set from your trunk![/p][p]There’s also a new way to remove vehicles from the street by calling for backup, you’re now able to arrest injured NPCs before they’re taken by EMS, and other helpful changes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Coming September 17: The Accident Skin Pack![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/e1302c8d0aa5bf1af52f3ef7d25f031ef6dbe661.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Stay visible, stay ready – with the [b]Accident Pack[/b], coming September 17! This DLC has everything you need to handle accident scenes confidently. Included are reflective clothing, an optional orange lightbar for your police car, the Multipurpose Responder Vehicle equipped with a bigger trunk for transporting more tools, and police vehicle skins that indicate you're taking care of the accident response. [/p][p]The Accident Pack will be released as a paid DLC and will be included for free in the Season Pass. If you haven't checked it out yet, we recommend doing so as it's by far the best deal if you want to be prepared for additional content we will release later this year:[/p][h3]  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597210/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers__Season_Pass/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h3][b]Also coming: Three beautiful Uniform Packs![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/199357908c1320dc56b2a0cb0b03788b69cf4d0d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Bring the style of the US Police Officers to your next shift! We're introducing three absolutely iconic [b]Uniform Pack DLC[/b], each containing a set of different uniforms inspired by actual police forces from the United States.[/p][p]The East Coast Police Uniform Pack contains 5 uniforms from New York City, New Hampshire, and Fairfax County. [/p][p]The South Atlantic Police Uniform Pack contains 6 uniforms from Florida, Georgia, and West Virginia.[/p][p]The Western Police Uniform Pack contains 6 uniforms from Las Vegas, Los Angeles, and Austin.[/p][p]Please note that the Uniform Packs are [b]not[/b] part of the Season Pass and must be purchased separately. However, we have created a bundle that will contain all three packs at a discounted price.[/p][p]The Uniform Packs will also release September 17![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Some final words[/b][/h3][p]That’s all for now, jump into the Open Beta today, and let us know what you think! Thank you so much for your support and stay tuned for what’s next! 💙[/p][p]And that said, here are today's patch notes:[/p][p][/p][h3]Changelog – Update 19.0 (Beta)[/h3][p][b]New Features, Improvements & Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Self-Defense[/p][/*][*][p]Added Gun Usage by NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Added Spotlights as Gadgets[/p][/*][*][p]Added a feature to change Uniforms from the Patrol Car Trunk[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional permits and new weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added radio chatter inside the patrol cars[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p][i]Gameplay[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed uniform settings reverting to default after restarting and continuing shift[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Stability & Performance[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed game momentarily freezing upon entering any shift before resuming normally[/p][/*][/list][p][i]NPC & NPV[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed injured witnesses in crime scenes can not be interviewed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Medics trying to walk into slightly injured NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed arrest transport officer not entering the Police Station to retrieve arrested NPC[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed arrest transport officer not walking back to their vehicle[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Patrol Cars & Gadgets[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed blipping uses same sequence as ELS[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Graphics & Game World[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed towing animation when NPC is handcuffed while vehicle is towed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dashboard reflections in some cars during first person[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues with grass on Highway[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various visual glitches[/p][/*][/list][p][i]UI[/i][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the camera within the garage when changing Stickers to allow for a better preview[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Ninja Stars to Throwing Stars[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: State of Development – Gun Usage is coming next month!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/b2e457ccc4a5a4a38ced61a9d6373edb84176c2f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fellow Officers,[/b][/p][p]yes, you've read the title correctly: One of the most frequently requested features is actually coming to Police Simulator. With Update 19.0, scheduled to arrive this September, [b]we're finally introducing Gun Usage[/b]![/p][p]Today, we want to share some first information about the scope of the update, the limitations of your service weapon, and a fair share of behind-the-scenes details.[/p][p]Let's take a closer look![/p][p][/p][h3][b]How Gun Usage will look like in PS:PO[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/397e10d8862da3da07423b9e260d0d2e827e4ba8.gif"][/img][/p][p]From the very beginning, we envisioned the use of a service weapon as a method of last resort. After all, the officers working in the Brighton Police Department have sworn to serve all citizens – fairly, in alignment with the law, and with justice.[/p][p]Currently, the service weapon can only be used in a very narrow scope. For example, you are allowed to draw and aim it at car thieves to force them to surrender. Other scenarios usually require different means, such as the stun gun or a swift tackle. Even just aiming at a citizen with your weapon will cause the loss of Conduct Points. In any case, you’ve never been allowed to [i]shoot[/i] your weapon.[/p][p]With Update 19.0, a new level of danger arrives that actually [i]requires [/i]the use of your gun, turning it into an useful tool inside your arsenal. You’re even allowed to shoot it! The use of your hand gun comes into play once all other forms of de-escalation have been exhausted. Let's explain![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/0df08c9e2019e072ee635440ea891a5817a2b8dc.gif"][/img][/p][p]When you approach a criminal, their level of danger is constantly influenced by a randomizer. This may cause some citizens to flee, carry an illegal weapon in their inventory, or trigger other variables. Now, [i]every[/i] criminal has a chance to be spawned with an extraordinarily high level of criminal activity – leading to a handgun in their inventory and them turning into an armed criminal. The City of Brighton is becoming way more dangerous![/p][p]This can happen at any point where a criminal NPC would usually decide to flee: if the randomizer determines that they are at a high criminal level, they may draw their weapon – otherwise, they simply start fleeing. This means: A car thief, a drug dealer, even a wanted NPC can turn into someone drawing a handgun, which will require you to draw your own weapon in return! But they may also just flee, which only requires lighter measures instead.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/09a1913b81b8926aec85c495680f9632913e386c.gif"][/img][/p][p]When an armed criminal draws a weapon, you will be notified by the game – and immediate action must be taken. The NPC will be marked with an outline, indicating the current level of threat:[/p][list][*][p][b]Yellow Outline:[/b] You're aiming at the armed criminal who has drawn their gun. You will now demand them to surrender. If they comply, they will drop their weapon, lie down, and you can handcuff them. If not, you are not yet allowed to shoot – doing so will not end the shift but will cause the loss of CP. It can take some time for the NPC to surrender as they might verbally resist.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Red Outline:[/b] The armed criminal refuses to surrender and is now an active threat. You are now allowed to shoot! The criminal has a chance to shoot at the player – but doesn't have to. After every shot you take, they may either turn into an injured NPC or drop their weapon and surrender. If the armed criminal is injured, first aid must be administered and an ambulance must be called for further proceedings.[/p][/*][/list][p]As described, you can also be shot by the armed criminal! After a maximum of three hits, you will become critically injured and your shift will automatically end as you need to recover. Act fast and decisively to protect yourself and everyone else![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Setting expectations right[/b][/h3][p]To be clear: Police Simulator will not suddenly turn into a third-person shooter. The introduction of an actual purpose for the service weapon changes the nature of the game in various aspects, requiring careful consideration across multiple areas. However, we believe we found the perfect balance that’s both fun and realistic![/p][p]After all, we’re still a simulation game that realistically covers the daily life of your average patrol officer.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Why did this feature not release earlier?[/b][/h3][p]Well, that’s a valid question! As described [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/997010/announcements/detail/6521815776484645649?snr=2___"]a while ago in a comprehensive blog post[/url], we encountered several hurdles we needed to overcome first. The most difficult aspect, however, was definitely the already issued age rating for the game.[/p][p]Currently, Police Simulator is rated as a game suited for teenagers, primarily because scenarios requiring gun usage are not present. But what happens if this suddenly changes? It should be no surprise that there is a risk of the age rating being raised – causing incredibly complex legal problems with people who bought the game when it still had the lower rating (not to mention the logistical nightmares of all retail copies).[/p][p]That's why we created several prototypes of the Gun Usage feature, tweaked countless variables, and adjusted many aspects after our initial talks with all relevant age rating agencies around the globe. Ultimately, we sent out a version we were really satisfied with – and that met our vision of fun, action, and a sense of danger. While most agencies passed our implementation without any problems, others actually required us to pursue a complete re-rating of the entire game.[/p][p]Good news, though: We have passed![/p][p]  [/p][h3][b]Changes on the timeline[/b][/h3][p]As mentioned previously, the next update with version number 19.0 will now be fully focused on Gun Usage. This, of course, means a change in the previously communicated development timeline![/p][p]The Mission Update, which was originally intended to be released as Update 19.0 in September, will now be part of Update 20.0 in October. All details about the new missions will be released at a later date.[/p][p][url="https://trello.com/b/YeMg9IAp/police-simulator-patrol-officers-update-roadmap"]The new timeline is now also available on Trello[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More details soon![/b][/h3][p]As we intend to release the Gun Usage Update in September, you can expect to try out the feature as part of our usual Open Beta beforehand. Please expect the Open Beta to be launched in early September.[/p][p]At that point, we will also reveal more details about the full update, a fixed release date, and additional footage![/p][p]Thank you so much for your support – we hope you’re already excited for the next update when it launches this September![/p][p][/p][p][b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Out now: The Quality-of-Life Update & Adventurer Police Vehicle!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/a3bfa2a7ebb40cbfb53c8ec432c42302bb3a7e34.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fellow Officers,[/b] [/p][p]several improvements, a bunch of bug fixes, and a lot of polishing: [b]The Quality-of-Life Update is now available across PC, PlayStation & Xbox![/b][/p][p]All changes have been inspired by your feedback and we couldn't be more grateful for that. Thank you everyone![/p][p]But now, let's take a closer look at the update![/p][p][/p][h3]In Short: What’s included?[/h3][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/d90f2a834054c8856a715a0c9b11c2d7265da519.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/cf0efc8d729fc42b57eb0506c4c114fd7a44edd8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/870d83e88ab7e0a55d409d70392402b6910a365f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/0483fe6172a503e8ce5aa50288bdf08ae4410988.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]This update is centered around making your overall gameplay experience smoother, more convenient, and more reliable. The changes we made are based on several community surveys we’ve conducted over the last few months.[/p][list][*][p]🗨️ Skip NPC Conversations[/p][list][*][p]Press 'Space': No need to listen to their full voice-over anymore![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🔴 CP Loss Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Across the board, we have resolved several problems with unjustified CP Loss. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]📷 New Camera Control Option: A floating camera mode is now available within the settings![/p][list][*][p]Head over to "[i]Settings >[/i] [i]Game > Camera > Looking Direction"[/i] to check it out![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]💊 New illegal items and drugs[/p][list][*][p]Citizens can now be under the influence of several other substances, and carry around some truly [i]dangerous[/i] objects![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🛣️ New Highway Turns[/p][list][*][p]This allows for more options for U-Turns and shorter distances in case you need to change to the opposite lane.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🚔 Catpaw Skin Collection #2[/p][list][*][p]New patrol car skins inspired by New York City, West Virginia, Georgia, and Los Angeles, created by ricobrzenska and Kittyraww![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🚘 NPCs get picked up by Tow Trucks[/p][list][*][p]Citizens will now be picked up by a tow truck if their car gets towed: NPCs will enter it and drive off.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🚨 Brighter ELS during day and night[/p][/*][*][p]🪲 Bug Fixes: Check out the full changelog further down below![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Introducing: The Adventurer Police Vehicle[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="ARTvbnkJCBk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Get behind the wheel of the ultimate SUV and enjoy cruising in a true symbol of American power and reliability: [b]The Adventurer Police Vehicle[/b]! Whether you're patrolling the streets of Brighton or going offroad in the wider state of Franklin, the APV offers a truly unique experience.[/p][p][i]Please note:[/i] There's currently a bug present where certain attachments do not work correctly. We have a hotfix already in the build pipeline which will release as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3768290/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Adventurer_Police_Vehicle_DLC/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The Adventurer Police Vehicle is included for free in the Season Pass! If you haven't checked it out yet, we recommend doing so as it's by far the best deal if you want to be prepared for additional content we will release later this year:[/p][p][/p][h3]  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597210/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers__Season_Pass/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][p][/p][h3]What's next?[/h3][p]As we have previously confirmed, we have temporarily removed the spotlights on all patrol cars as we plan to ship them as a proper gadget in the future. This way, you can enable them during your shift independently from the Matrix Sign and also have an additional customization option. The spotlights will come back as soon as possible - thank you for your continued patience![/p][p]While we would normally reveal the content of the next update at this point already, we can't do it yet as we're still preparing some exciting and frequently-requested features. We're sorry that we can't reveal them at this point but would ask you to stay tuned, it won't take much longer![/p][p]Thank you so much for your support and we hope you’re excited to check out The Quality-of-Life Update! But for now, let's take a good look at the official changelog of this update:[/p][p][/p][h3]Changelog – Update 18.0[/h3][p][b]New Features, Improvements & Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new camera mode for freely floating camera[/p][/*][*][p]Added new illegal items and drug states[/p][/*][*][p]Added NPCs entering the Tow Truck when their car gets towed[/p][/*][*][p]Added possibility to skip conversations[/p][/*][*][p]Added some new U-Turns on Highway[/p][/*][*][p]Made ELS brighter during day and night[/p][/*][*][p]Added four new skins powered by ricobrzenska and Kittyraww and inspired by New York City, West Virginia, Georgia, and Los Angeles![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p][i]Gameplay[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed several issues with CP Loss[/p][list][*][p]Fixed CP Loss when arresting someone for cannabis[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous CP Loss issues connected to car thieves[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed CP Loss for missing evidence on parked vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed CP Loss when asking for ID of truck driver in weigh station callout[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed CP Loss when giving ticket and towing car parking on bus stop[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed canceling tow truck while interacting with it gets player stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed no reason available to detain Stolen Truck drivers[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Multiplayer[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed that clients cannot switch gadgets notes.title: The Quality-of-Life Update Launches on July 22, 2025 – Beta Update #2 is here!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/d6a6db0895eb3ff7db3598cad1e2d77409f954f5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fellow Officers,[/b] [/p][p]just last week, we've launched the first Open Beta for the upcoming Quality-of-Life Update. Thank you all for your incredibly valuable feedback – we've been able to identify several issues and have fixed many of them already.[/p][p]Today, we've released a new update for the Open Beta that includes both several additional improvements and fixes. With that, we're also happy to reveal the final release date for the next update: [b]It will now release on July 22, 2025 across PC, PlayStation & Xbox![/b][/p][p]Let's take a closer look![/p][p][/p][h3]How do I join the Open Beta?[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/fac4645ba5008b425eae2dd248eccaf1a296b95d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You're not participating in the Open Beta yet? Don't miss your chance to try out the update before its official release![/p][olist][*][p]Open [b]Steam[/b] and go to your Library [/p][/*][*][p]Right-click on [i]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/i] [/p][/*][*][p]Click [b]Properties[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]Select the [b]Betas[/b] tab [/p][/*][*][p]Choose [b]"Open_Beta"[/b] from the dropdown list [/p][/*][/olist][p]Steam will now download a small update. Once complete, you’re in! Afterwards, you can download the game to try out Update 18.0![/p][p]If you encounter any issues, please share them in the [url="https://discord.gg/astragon"]#police-beta-chat channel on our Discord[/url]. You can also use our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/997010/discussions/2/"]dedicated Beta Forums[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]What's included in The Quality-of-Life Update?[/h3][p][/p][p]With The Quality-of-Life Update, we're bundling a bunch of smaller and larger improvements to increase the overall look-and-feel of Police Simulator: Patrol Officers.[/p][p]For example, you are able to skip conversations by pressing space – no need to listen to a citizen's voice-over any longer. In addition, a new freely floating camera mode is now available within the settings: Head over to "[i]Settings >[/i] [i]Game > Camera > Looking Direction"[/i] to check it out![/p][p]We've also introduced several new illegal items and drug states, leading to much more comprehensive tests. Citizens will now be picked up by a tow truck if their car gets towed: NPCs will enter it and drive off. Our team has also adjusted the light setup for police cars, ensuring much brighter and more visible lights both at day and at night.[/p][p][/p][h3]What has changed with Open Beta #2?[/h3][p]Thanks to your feedback, we have made several adjustements in comparison to the first version from last week. This includes:[/p][list][*][p]Several additional CP Loss Fixes, including:[/p][list][*][p]When arresting someone for cannabis[/p][/*][*][p]Several issues when interacting with a car thief [/p][/*][*][p]For missing evidence on parked vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]When asking for ID of a truck driver in a weigh station callout[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Several Localization Fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Highway Turns:[/p][list][*][p]This allows for more options for U-Turns and shorter distances in case you need to change to the opposite lane.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved Adventure Police Vehicle DLC:[/p][list][*][p]Based on your feedback, we have made [url="https://x.com/PolSimulator/status/1941226939987218731"]several adjustements to the upcoming APV[/url]. We made it longer, adjusted the windows and have also flattened it a bit. This APV is not playable in the beta build, but changes have been made regardless![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]The Adventurer Police Vehicle will be released as a paid DLC and will be included for free in the Season Pass. If you haven't checked it out yet, we recommend doing so as it's by far the best deal if you want to be prepared for additional content we will release later this year:[/p][p]  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597210/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers__Season_Pass/"][/dynamiclink]We have also fixed several bugs with this new beta version. This includes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed Most Traffic Lights are not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed handcuffed NPC walking away in random direction[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed colours on red-blue ELS not matching[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bullbar floating after police vehicle is damaged[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed illegal item gun evidence added even if NPC has a valid permit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed no reason available to detain Stolen Truck drivers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Broken Down Vehicle NPCs do not enter Tow Truck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed arrest transport officer not entering the Police Station to retrieve arrested NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed NPC that are released from the scene to not move[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bumper lights of Unmarked Police Cars floating in place after vehicle damage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some lighting issues on Dinosaur Statue[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed canceling tow truck while interacting with it causes the player to get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed entire Highway level despawning if Client leaves the Multiplayer session[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing clients not being able to switch gadgets during Multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue to ensure clients get grey-out elements being displayed corresponding to the host content in the garage during Multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed NPC driver staying in laying position after being handcuffed by Client in Multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash while joining a Multiplayer session[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash after calling tow truck and driving away from the scene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Button glyphs are missing for both Controller and KB keybindings on the Microsoft Store Build[/p][/*][/list][p]We are aware of some additional issues which we plan to fix as soon as possible. This includes a CP Loss issue at bus stops, non-interactable NPCs on minor accident sites in multiplayer, and issues with crossplay. [/p][p][/p][p]Enough said! Please check out the latest beta version and let us know your feedback. Thank you so much for your support and stay tuned for what’s next! 💙[/p][p][/p][p][b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: State of Development – A first look at The Quality-of-Life Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/260fd870fe4e29c5953aa5451f4cf5d0f878699f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fellow Officers,[/b][/p][p]our team is currently hard at work on the next big update: [b]The Quality-of-Life Update[/b], currently scheduled to be released at the end of July – with an Open Beta launching earlier.[/p][p]Today, we want to share a quick update about the current state of development, how things are progressing, and a first look at some of the work we have already finished.[/p][p]Let's take a closer look![/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Convenience[/b][/h3][p]
As we have previously announced, the next update is centered around making your overall gameplay experience smoother, more convenient, and more reliable.[/p][p]Over the past few months, we've conducted several community surveys to better understand how we can improve the game in various aspects - from minor inconveniences to major revisions. Thank you so much for your participation![/p][p]One of the features being introduced with The Quality-of-Life Update is the ability to finally skip conversations – so you won't have to listen to citizens complaining that their fine is too expensive when you're in a rush. Based on our own experience… well, this will speed up things quite a bit.[/p][p]We’re also resolving several issues on the Highway: Vehicles will no longer spawn in front of accidents and some graphical issues with trees and grass will be improved. In addition, multiple crashes related to Assistance Vehicles have been fixed to ensure greater game stability – and we'll enable the option to switch to a free rotating camera on foot![/p][p]Further improvements are still in progress, and we will announce more details shortly before release. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Code of Conduct Points[/b][/h3][p]
We’re also refactoring the entire Conduct Points Systems to allow for greater reliability in the future. This way, we want to ensure no unintended loss of Conduct Points can happen anymore as this has previously been the case under a few circumstances. The team is currently still busy working on the overhaul, but we’re already very optimistic about the improvements!

[/p][h3][b]What’s in your bag?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/e7b214f6d9a9edd82d4a7cc27c5a920fddc00ef7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Apparently, a new supermarket has opened and the citizens of Brighton will carry around multiple new items inside their bags – no worries, they’re still addicted to good-ol’ damp raisins. The screenshot above shows just a few of them! [/p][p]What about Ninja Stars? Previously, we have announced that they will finally be classified as an illegal item. That is indeed still the intention, but work on the underlying system still needs a little bit more time. At this moment, we’re still not completely confident that they will make it into the next update – but hopefully soon afterwards![/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Brighter Lights[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]You all  love the new blue-and-red lights, but want to have them even brighter? No worries, we’ve put some touches on the entire system to improve the lighting – primarily concerning the front lights. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]What about spotlights?[/b][/h3][p]
In one of the most recent updates, we have temporarily removed the spotlights on all patrol cars as we plan to ship them as a proper gadget in the future. This way, you can enable them during your shift independently from the Matrix Sign and also have an additional customization option.[/p][p]However, we’re currently not confident enough that we will be able to ship the spotlights as a gadget just in time for The Quality-of-Life Update. As we still need to put some finishing touches on them, we currently estimate that they will ship a little bit later – but definitely as soon as possible.

[/p][h3][b]No more stranded NPCs[/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="PB57qDm6kl0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
After you helped a fellow citizen who’s involved in a car accident, previously it would result in their car being towed and them becoming, well, stranded. As a service-oriented Police Department, we could not longer tolerate this and instructed our Tow Trucks to take care of the citizens – by providing them with a passenger ride out of courtesy.[/p][p]The video above shows the new mechanic in action – which will become especially useful on the Highway![/p][p][/p][h3][b]A new Patrol Car[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/c20c02e3540466039fa9670bde69d7d11ae4c67a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We heard your feedback loud and clear: A new patrol car is coming, available as an optional paid DLC and for free to everyone who owns the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597210/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers__Season_Pass/?snr=1_5_9__405"]brand-new Season Pass[/url]![/p][p]Say hello to the [b]Adventurer Police Vehicle[/b], resembling one of the most popular and common police vehicles in the United States. Whether you're patrolling the streets of Brighton or going offroad in the wider state of Franklin, the APV offers a truly unique experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Even more options![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/f009c166c15b95dd6026f6f8a5310c93dda94d3f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’re also pleased to expand the [b]Catpaw Skin Collection[/b] with four additional liveries – this time inspired by [i]New York, Georgia, Los Angeles and West Virginia[/i] – and once again created in close collaboration with [b]ricobrzenska and Kittyraww[/b] who provided some fantastic support![/p][p]These beautiful skins will be included for [i]free[/i] with The Quality-of-Life Update inside the garage. Above, you can see them being lined up on the parking lot of our development build – the implementation only happened a few moments ago 😉[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Some final words[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Next to general gameplay improvements, we’re also highly focused on once again [i]fixing as many bugs as possible[/i]. Our team is currently still busy tackling dozens of bugs while our QA is already verifying claimed fixes in parallel. More details will follow closer to release![/p][p]Please keep reporting issues that you encounter, the more detailed and reproducible the problems are the easier they are for us to address.[/p][p]Our experienced group of community beta testers will also been given early access to the development build very soon, and they are already providing a lot of feedback towards the final version. For the first time in almost two years, there will also be a public beta again: Very soon, [i]all of you[/i] will be granted access to the latest build on a dedicated beta branch. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/644691200809369688?snr=1_5_9_"]You can find more information about that in our last blog post.[/url][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support and we hope you’re already excited for The Quality-of-Life Update when it launches this July![/p][p][/p][p][b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: With the next update: Open Betas on Steam are coming back!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/7e3b21177a9eca06534d4a7bd6761c5e1dac8901.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fellow Officers,[/b][/p][p]We’re currently working hard on the next update, tentatively titled [url="https://trello.com/b/YeMg9IAp/police-simulator-patrol-officers-update-roadmap"]‘The Quality-of-Life Update’[/url]. Whilst we’ll be sharing details about the exact content very soon, we’re excited to announce the [b]return of Open Betas[/b] on Steam today – starting with the next update! 🎉[/p][p]Each Open Beta will launch up to two weeks before the planned release of the full update, allowing all of you to take an early look at the new content, improvements, and fixes. This way, we can collect your feedback much earlier to ensure we can incorporate as much as possible for the full release – allowing us to deliver smoother, more polished updates.[/p][p][/p][h3]Who will be able to join the Open Beta?[/h3][p][i]Everyone [/i]who owns Police Simulator on Steam! Sadly, we won’t be able to perform any kind of beta on other platforms.[/p][p][/p][h3]Besides content, will there be any differences to the normal branch?[/h3][p]Yes: Due to the version difference between the beta and the normal branches, crossplay between Steam & Xbox will not work when playing in the beta branch. However, general multiplayer between two Steam players who are both on the beta branch will continue to function.[/p][p]Please note that the beta branch is always subject to potential instability issues.[/p][p][/p][h3]How will I be able to join the Open Beta?[/h3][p]We've made the process as easy as possible to include you, the community, early on during the development of the game. Once the next update enters Open Beta, you just need to perform the following steps to join:[/p][olist][*][p]Right-click on Police Simulator: Patrol Officers in your Steam library.[/p][/*][*][p]Select 'Properties' in the menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Select 'Betas' in the sidebar on the left.[/p][/*][*][p]Select 'Public Beta' in the drop-down menu and confirm your decision to switch to that branch.[/p][/*][*][p]An update should now start - you are now officially part of the Open Beta![/p][/*][/olist][p]To switch back to the ‘normal’ version of the game, just repeat these steps again – but instead of selecting 'Public Beta', you just select 'None'. Easy.[/p][p][/p][h3]How will I be able to provide feedback?[/h3][p]Everyone can test the beta extensively and provide feedback on its features, balancing, and bugs. Feel free to send us your impressions on [url="http://discord.gg/astragon"]Discord[/url], in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/997010/discussions/2/"]Steam Beta forums[/url] and [url="https://wonderl.ink/@policesimulator"]on our Socials[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]When will the next update launch?[/h3][p]The Quality-of-Life Update is currently scheduled to be released in July! Obviously, the first Open Beta starts 1-2 weeks prior. notes.title: Out Now: The Garage & Tools Update!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/965e33c7afe8916c301d08f18ce3980cf2ba2d04.jpg"][/img]
[b]Fellow Officers,[/b]

It’s time to pimp your ride and customize the patrol cars to your needs:[b] The Garage & Tools Update is now available across PC, PlayStation & Xbox![/b]

Today’s update is centered around further personalization options while also including a bunch of necessary fixes, improvements, and additional free content. Let’s have a closer look at the details!

[/p][h3]In Short: What’s included?[/h3][p]
Not much time on your hand? No worries, if you want to dive in with no further ado, here’s a tl;dr:

 🎨 Customization Options: Lightbars, Spoilers, Rims, Bullbars, and Stickers
 🚨 Red & Blue Lights: Looks nice. Blue-white is still an option!
 📷 ALPR: This new tool can be equipped for all patrol cars and automatically scans license plates in front of you for violations concerning the respective car
 🇺🇸 Catpaw Skin Collection: New patrol car skins inspired by Las Vegas, New Hampshire, Florida, and Fairfax County
 🤝 Crossplay: Between PC & Xbox (and release on Xbox Game Pass!)
 🪲 Bug Fixes: From AI to CP Loss
 👥 Multiplayer Fixes: For a better time together
 ⚙️ Gadget Swapping: Every gadget can now be equipped for every car (you must own the respective gadget via connected DLC)
 •	…and more!
Need a deep-dive? We got you covered:

[/p][h3]Pimp Your Patrol[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/ad2b7145eb1747c9817036afaf825035ed324e53.jpg"][/img]It’s time for a makeover. Inside the garage, there’s now a [b]brand-new customization tab[/b] where you can choose between a total of 18 different free attachments which can be applied to all patrol cars – from the Panther Z to the CPV. Which attachments, you might ask? Rims, spoilers, bullbars, lightbars, and stickers! The spoilers also come in a variety of colors while the lightbars now consist of two different light settings, leading to [b]a total of 30 options[/b] to customize your patrol cars! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/b2a7775b6b7f8757df55b4e7d5788618da73cdb0.jpg"][/img]Wait, did we just say… two lights? Next to the already available blue/white setting, you can now also choose a[b] red/blue one[/b]! These are available for every single lightbar and can be adjusted, like all the other options, inside the garage.

In addition, owners of the Unmarked Pack can now choose to remove the lightbar altogether, even in combination with a ‘normal’ police livery. This way, you can finally [b]drive a slicktop police car[/b]! You’re welcome, officers.

[/p][h3]Gadgets Without Limits[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/af99b0d201c5df8a4648aa5ddd44b71dd62bf053.jpg"][/img]Over the last few years, we’ve released a bunch of amazing patrol cars – and almost all of them came with a unique gadget to improve your life as a patrol officer. However, all gadgets were only usable with the car they were originally designed for. Now, you are able to [b]attach every gadget to every patrol car [/b]– with zero limits.

[i]Please note that you must own the gadget via the respective DLC to attach it to other cars.
[/i]
This means that you can even have all gadgets enabled all at once, smoothly switching between them while on the ride. You’re at an accident site? Turn on the Matrix Sign or use the Winch to tow the car to a different area! Need to catch up to a fleeing car? Let’s grant yourself a boost with Launch Control and tackle them with the Snare Net… the choice is yours.

In addition, when activating the Matrix Sign at accident sites, the [b]spotlights turn on for all patrol cars [/b]and greatly improve visibility – especially useful at night! You can now also choose between putting the Matrix Sign underneath the light bar on top of the car or behind the rear window.

[/p][h3]A New Free Tool: Hello, ALPR!
[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/4f188816ce63131762776df4525e90a4a34028da.jpg"][/img]The Brighton Police Department has always invested in further research and development to ensure its officers have steady access to the latest-and-greatest technology. Thanks to the new update, you are now able to equip [b]the brand-new license plate scanner (ALPR)[/b] as an additional free gadget!

This gadget automatically scans and collects all available information about the license plates and the respective cars if they are ahead of the player in a direct line of sight, even if they are slightly to the left and right. You can easily check for potential registered violations and remarks, prompting a potential report and pull-over if proven to be necessary.

[/p][h3]Bug Fixes & Other Improvements
[/h3][p]
With today's update, we're also fixing a bunch of issues while improving general performance and stability. One big focus of ours was the general multiplayer performance which we tackled across several areas. Get on patrol with a partner and let us know your feedback!

We plan to introduce further improvements in the near future with the next big update – more about that further down below.

[/p][h3]Local Representation[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/4fbfd83d63e7f3b9869a220c26c6b28611f4cbbf.jpg"][/img]We’re also pleased to introduce the [b]Catpaw Skin Collection[/b], a brand-new set of four beautiful liveries inspired by [i]Las Vegas, New Hampshire, Florida, and Fairfax County[/i] – and created in close collaboration with ricobrzenska and Kittyraww who provided some great support!

These skins are now available for free for all patrol cars inside the garage! A good start already, but which region do you want to represent next?

[/p][h3]Breaking Boundaries: Crossplay Is Here![/h3][p]
As officers of the Brighton Police Department, we always strive to bring people and communities closer together. Building bridges is important – across platforms.

With today’s update, we’re finally introducing [b]full crossplay between PC & Xbox[/b]! Bring along a friend and start your next shift together 🤝

[/p][h3]Even More Options![/h3][p]
You can’t get enough of customization? No worries: Just for you, we have also created a completely optional Vehicle Customization Pack that is now available as a paid DLC.

The Vehicle Customization Pack provides more than 30 additional parts and accessories so that you can personalize your department vehicles exactly how you like!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597220/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers__Vehicle_Customization_Pack/"][/dynamiclink]

Alongside the completely free updates, we plan to launch some additional paid content this year to support the further development of the game. To reward our most loyal officers, we’ve created a Season Pass that will provide access to all of these DLC with a total discount of 37% in comparison to purchasing them individually. The Vehicle Customization Pack is, of course, also included!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597210/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers__Season_Pass/"][/dynamiclink]

[/p][h3]Police Simulator 💚 Game Pass[/h3][p]
We’re also happy to announce that, at the exact same time as the update, Police Simulator: Patrol Officers is now available on Xbox Game Pass across PC and Console! 💚

Subscribers of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, PC Game Pass and Xbox Game Pass Standard receive full access to the main game – the perfect opportunity to finally join the Brighton Police Department!

Say hello to all of our new recruits! 👋

[/p][h3]What’s Next?[/h3][p]
Just this week, we have started our work on the next big update, currently being labeled as the ‘Quality-of-Life Update’. In recent months, we held several polls within the community to better understand how we could improve the game across several aspects – from minor inconveniences to greater overhauls. Thank you so much for your participation!

Current contenders and high up on our list of changes we want to tackle are, for example, a comprehensive overhaul of the CP system to prevent issues like losing CP when aiming your service pistol at a carnapper before said suspect has entered the vehicle. Other improvements include radio chatter in the background for further immersion, making ELS lights brighter during the day, being able to tow larger trucks, and a more useful mini map that provides additional details. Please note that these are currently just a fraction of our list and work has only just begun – we’ll update you very soon about the planned scope.

Keep your feedback coming!

[url="https://trello.com/b/YeMg9IAp/police-simulator-patrol-officers-update-roadmap"]Please check out our Trello for further information.[/url]

[/p][h3]Final Words[/h3][p]
We hope you enjoy today’s update and we can’t wait for everything else we’re going to ship in 2025. But for now, let's take a good look at the official changelog of this update:

[/p][h3]Changelog – Update 17.0[/h3][p]
[b]New Features & Content[/b]

 Added new customization options: Bullbars, Lightbars, Rims, Spoilers, and Stickers
 Added red/blue Lightbar Patterns
 Added additional skins, powered by ricobrzenska and Kittyraww
 Added option to make all gadgets available for all patrol cars
 Added New Tool: ALPR
 Enabled Crossplay between PC & Xbox

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[i]Gameplay[/i]

 Fixed evidence markers disappearing when trying to equip them
 Fixed driving into a red barrier and then selecting another shift crashes the game and then leads to corrupted save data
 Added non-vehicle spawn zone in front of a Highway Accident
 Adjusted the search light

[i]Multiplayer[/i]

 Included several multiplayer improvements for overall better stability, performance, and enjoyment
 Fixed shifts disappearing for host if the multiplayer session is being created in the shift selection screen
 Fixed client falling through the world after switching patrol cars inside the garage

[i]Stability & Performance[/i]

 Fixed a bunch of crashes
 Included some additional stability improvements

[i]NPC & NPV[/i]

 Fixed a soft-lock when re-ordering NPV driver out after letting them go
 Fixed NPCs floating a lot in the city or in vehicles, leading to progress being blocked
 Fixed fleeing NPV losing collision to other NPVs and Tow Truck during a Roadblock Callout
Fixed extra / duplicate drug dealer NPC spawning at a callout location

[i]Patrol Cars & Gadgets[/i]

 Fixed some skinning issues with the FPV
 Fixed winch cable being offset from gadget position

[i]Graphics & Game World[/i]

 Fixed NPV License Plates not being correctly attached to the bumper of some NPVs
 Fixed undercover toolbelt only being selectable as male
 Fixed blue barriers at Melting Pot Police Station clipping into a wall
 Fixed Z-Fighting occurring on a wall of the Melting Pot Police Station
 Fixed several bins visibly clipping into a wall
 Fixed several clipping issues inside the city

[i]UI[/i]

 Fixed trunk menu displaying nothing for Police Vehicles in garage
 Fixed input loss in garage after switching focus
 FIxed multiple localization issues inside the garage
 Updated Handbook with latest information
[/p]

notes.title: State of Development – How the next update is progressing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/2352808644064246f05eb4e5d3cff7db4cd525ae.jpg[/img]

[b]Fellow Officers,[/b]

We are currently hard at work on the next big update and so far, things are coming together quite smoothly as we continue to polish the new content and fix as many bugs as we can.

Today, we’re sharing a quick but comprehensive update about how development is progressing, what we have already finished working on, and some first footage right from our development builds! 👀

As we have previously announced, the next update is centered around enabling much greater customization for your patrol cars. We’ve created a modular system of attachments which can be interchanged and adjusted so that you can make your vehicle truly your own – and giving you way cooler customization options overall.

Let’s take a closer look!

[h3]New Cosmetic Options[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/2b35f7ebf668cefedbce5daedf03c24a099c8590.jpg[/img]
With the next update you will be able to choose from a [b]variety of different free cosmetics[/b] for your patrol cars, all thanks to the new customization tab in the garage. These brand-new cosmetics include rims, spoilers, bullbars, lightbars, and stickers! 🚔

[i]An additional set of cosmetics will be made available via a small paid DLC, with details to be announced soon.
[/i]
BTW: The new lightbars aren’t just there for show, they have also been upgraded…

[h3]Red & Blue Lights[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/51c74ba184857d6fb134dc958fe73c5516f8486b.jpg[/img]
They’re coming! For as long as we can think of, one of the most frequently requested additions has been the inclusion of [b]red-and-blue lights for your ELS[/b]. You will now be able to select them as an optional color scheme – no worries, the old option is still there and ready to be chosen! 🚨

[h3]New free gadget: License Plate Scanner[/h3]

The Brighton Police Department wants its officers to always have the latest-and-greatest technology available to them, right at their fingertips. The [b]brand-new license plate scanner[/b] can be equipped to every patrol car and will assist you greatly in your next shift! 🙏

This gadget automatically scans and collects all available information about the license plates and the respective cars if they are ahead of the player in a direct line of sight. Players will be able to check for potential registered violations and remarks, prompting a potential report and pull-over if proven to be necessary.

We’re still working on this gadget which is why we can’t show it to you quite yet – but we will share more information closer to the release with you!

[h3]Swap your Gadgets![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/d32f404bb7595c7d313614eea8af9a9259037609.jpg[/img]
Almost every patrol car we released also comes with a unique gadget to improve your life as a patrol officer. However, in the past, these gadgets were only usable with the car they were originally designed for.

This now changes with the new update: Right from the garage, you will be able to [b]attach every gadget to every patrol car![/b] Wanna use the winch on a CPV? No problem. Interested in boosting the Panther Z with some launch control? Easy as that! 💪

Please note that you must own the gadget via the respective DLC to attach it to other cars. 

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

As always, we’re also highly focused on[b] fixing as many bugs as possible[/b] while also providing a set of improvements. The team is currently tackling dozens and dozens of different bugs while our QA – in parallel – is already verifying claimed fixes.

Just one example: A bunch of players has reported that when starting a multiplayer session with a friend, they are not able to see any shifts across the shift selection screen. We have found the underlying problem and resolved it. We also resolved problems with disappearing evidence markers, floating NPCs during the Wanted callout, graphical glitches, and much more. 

As we’re still checking which bugs are confirmed to be fixed, we can’t provide a full list yet. This will happen closer to release.

Our experienced group of community beta testers has also been given early access to the development build, and they are already providing a lot of feedback towards the final version. A huge shoutout to all of them!

[h3]Wrapping it all up: Some final words[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/97677473c9af20f13f4b0c3810b6f6807142f5ac.jpg[/img]
New cosmetics, red & blue lights, a new free gadget, swappable gadgets, lots of fixed bugs – we hope you’re excited for the update when it finally launches next month across PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.

There are still a bunch of welcome surprises and additions for the update yet to be revealed, and we can’t wait to share more details with you very soon! 😊

Stay tuned for that!

Please keep reporting issues that you encounter, the more detailed and reproducible the problems are the easier they are for us to address. Keep telling us what you would like to see in the game - your feedback and engagement are highly appreciated. Thank you!

[b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/
