notes.title: Patch 16.1.2 – Bug fixes, improvements, and more details about the next update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/d01e41191466aa27add6959b8f30209710ac9131.jpg[/img]

[b]Fellow Officers,[/b]
it's now official: [b][i]Welcome to Police Simulator in 2025![/i][/b]

After [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/542222169408540202]last week's announcement of a whole year of free updates[/url], the very first one arrives... [i]today[/i]! This preparational patch serves as a kick-off for future updates – fixing a bunch of bugs, improving several aspects of NPC behavior, plus enhancing stability, performance, and multiplayer synchronization.

You can find the full patch notes further down below!

Here's a note regarding crashes: If you experience one, please send it to us via this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeDzQd4w9Tub2EjPssPcSIOW6FfGzfLJcI659CfagA07DoqJg/viewform]simple and straightforward Google Form[/url]. Thank you! 🫶

[h3]Looking forward[/h3]

Scheduled for the second quarter of the year, [b]The Car Customization Update[/b] ([i]not the final name[/i]) will allow for greater and extended personalization of your entire fleet.

A brand-new customization tab will be enabled within the garage, allowing you to better adjust the patrol cars to your liking! Currently, we plan to include options for modifying bull bars, spoilers, lightbars, and rims, as well as applying trunk stickers. The most popular additions will be available for free to everyone (before you ask: yes, this [i]does[/i] include the option for red-and-blue lights!), [b]while select additional ones will be available via a small paid DLC.[/b]

Additionally, you'll be able to customize the gadgets on each car. Want to see the winch on your UTV instead of just on the MPV? Now’s your chance to create the machine of your dreams for your next shift!

[i]Please note: You must own the gadget via the respective patrol car DLC to use it on another patrol car.[/i]

Work on this update has only just begun and we will share more details with you in the near future! You have feedback, wishes, and suggestions here already? Put them into the comments! :)

And now, let's finally dive into today's patch notes:

[h3]Changelog – Update 16.1.2[/h3]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Wanted Person spawning in unreachable places
[*] Fixed being unable to talk to a carnapper who was tackled after an accident
[*] Added a 'non-vehicle spawn zone' in front of a highway accident 
[*] Reduced the despawn range for cars not in your peripheral view
[*] Fixed being unable to ticket a car for having an expired license plate
[/list]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a discrepancy between client and host where the client sees different damage models than the host
[*] Fixed a desync of NPCs between the client and host after start a new shift
[*] Fixed smoke particles from the engine of a patrol car not being visible for the client
[*] Fixed FPV launch control getting cancelled for the client
[*] Fixed client not being able to open the board computer when inside the FPV
[*] Fixed cars sometimes having two NPCs in the driver seat of a vehicle when the host is too far away
[/list]

[b]Stability & Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple crashes
[*] Generally improved stability and performance
[/list]

[b]NPC & NPV[/b]
[list]
[*] NPVs now better avoid you when you’re coming from the opposite direction
[*] Fixed NPCs floating a lot in the city or inside vehicles
[*] Fixed people being stranded on the highway (After being 'let go', the NPC despawn automatically one you move a bit further away from them while not having them in your peripheral view)
[*] Fixed trucks involved in accidents blocking the traffic too much
[*] Fixed carnapper trying to leave in the car they've previously stolen
[*] Fixed medics exiting on the codriver side breaking the entire ambulance behavior
[*] Fixed NPVs unable to unpark when they're near a player while the police siren is enabled
[/list]

[b]Patrol Cars[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed patrol cars not being parked correctly in the parking lot of the precinct to better reflect real-life behavior: They now face the road, previously they were facing the building
[/list]

[b]Graphics & Game World[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a broken glass reflection in the precincts
[*] Fixed A poses when the character presets are being changed at the locker
[/list]

[b]Sounds[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed foot steps still being audible even though the SFX volume has been set to 0
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed no callout marker being shown on the map for an NPC that requires arrest transport
[*] Fixed marker visibility for both the mini map and multiplayer
[*] Added a missing translation string related to the Unmarked DLC
[*] Fixed legend UI falsely being shown in district and shift selection screens
[/list]

[i]Already known issue:[/i] Subtitles can't be disabled, will be fixed next week

notes.title: FREE Updates are coming: Welcome to Police Simulator in 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/1c2acef5b7cbe6657ed4d3c913b9bd0a8f386ac8.png[/img]

[b]Fellow Officers,[/b]
it's crazy to say this, but 2025 marks the [i]fourth[/i] anniversary of Police Simulator: Patrol Officers – what an incredible journey it has been!

From expanding the game based on your feedback during Early Access and launching on consoles to releasing the Highway Patrol Expansion, as a police officer in Brighton you've certainly witnessed plenty of changes throughout your career. What if we told you that this year will be no different?

Today, we're kicking off a new exciting year of Police Simulator:

[b]New, completely free updates are coming for the whole of 2025![/b]

The Police Simulator team can't wait to expand, improve and advance your life as a police officer of Brighton even further – with fresh content, numerous improvements, several quality-of-life enhancements, and much more.

In the recent weeks and months, we've been working on a new roadmap that is now also available on [url=https://trello.com/b/YeMg9IAp/police-simulator-patrol-officers-update-roadmap]our official Trello[/url] which we also overhauled to better reflect the imminent big updates. We wanted to ensure that we're not just introducing new content to expand the Police Simulator universe but also enhance [i]existing[/i] systems to make them more enjoyable and seamless to experience.

[b]Here's just a glimpse of what's in store for 2025:
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/9a7f0256ba1e93dbcc790f7d3bf6b012fcb7a39f.jpg[/img]

[h3]⚡ Preparation Update (ETA: March 2025)[/h3]
The very first update will be released this month to further polish the game and prepare it for all future updates that will be released in 2025.

[h3]🚔 Car Customization (ETA: Q2 2025)[/h3]
With this update, we will allow for more customization of your vehicles within the garage by enabling the ability to swap tools between vehicles which have previously been exclusive to a specific car model (e.g. speedometer of the Surveillance Police Vehicle), plus the addition of brand new interchangeable attachments like lights, decals, and rims – among other changes.

[h3]📈 QOL Improvements (ETA: Q2/Q3 2025)[/h3]
This update introduces a bunch of frequently-requested quality-of-life improvements, including adjustments to the Conduct Points System, and more. 

[h3]👮‍♀️ New Missions (ETA: Q3 2025)[/h3]
Crime has begun to spread all over Brighton. It's time to tackle new missions!

[h3]💬 Callout Rework (ETA: Q4 2025)[/h3]
We will rework the entire callout system – and enable players to spawn callouts of their choice, customize the callout balance, and more.

[h3]⚙️ ... and more![/h3]
Of course, we will release smaller updates in-between the listed bigger content drops to allow for further bug-fixing and polishing – all based on [i]your feedback[/i]. We are also exploring the option for additional paid content to support the development of the game. A select group of community members will also be able to playtest every update as early as possible and provide their guidance during development!

[b]Sound's great, doesn't it?[/b]

We [i]can't [/i]wait for another amazing year of Police Simulator on Steam, PlayStation, and Xbox. In addition, there's some additional secret content to be released... but we gotta keep this hidden for now. More details will be shared once we can, but in the meantime, please look forward to the very first update in just a few days!

Thank you for your continous support and see you back on patrol,
[b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/

notes.title: A Quick Update about Modding
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/d20af87fb4da44009f4850c1939dc7a8b2066a77.jpg[/img]

[b]Hey everyone,
[/b]
in recent weeks, we have released several new free uniforms that can be enjoyed by everyone – and as some of you have noticed, they are far more detailed and complex than the ones we had before.

As we have overhauled the entire way uniforms are created and how the underlying systems work, previously created uniform mods are [b]no longer compatible[/b] with the game. We apologize for any inconvenience and that it took us such a long time to communicate this properly. If you have previously published a uniform mod, you must adjust them according to the new modding process to make them compatible again. As a benefit, the new uniforms allow for far more flexibility and creativity while enabling you to also adjust parts of the outfits which were previously inaccessible. We hope you'll enjoy them!

To help you with that, we have now updated the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2782471905][b]modkits[/b][/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2780493511][b]templates[/b][/url] to ensure that modders get as many files and templates as possible. We even included multiple uniforms you can take inspiration from – and a comprehensive README in the ExampleMod folder that explains how the new modding process works.

You can now also mod unmarked vehicles! To do that, check out the manifest.json in the car vehicle modpacks and make sure to adjust "IsUnmarked" in the header to either "True" or "False", depending on what you want to create.

[b]Other modding issues[/b]

Very recently, we have released an update that fixed an issue that caused the RNA Layer to blend through any livery mod. To clarify: This is an issue that was completely on our end and no modder was at fault for this. We apologize to all modders who might have received negative comments regarding this bug.

We are aware of other miscellaneous problems with mods. If you have stumbled upon one, feel free to write them down in the comments below (at best with footage). We will take a look at them!

[b]Join the community[/b]

Multiple modders have joined the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/astragon][b]astragon Discord server[/b][/url] to chat with other members of the Police Simulator Modding Community. We have a dedicated channel (#police-modding) available for that which you can access after granting yourself the 'Police Simulator Fan' role.

In addition, we will select a few modders to a [i]secret [/i]channel where you can talk directly to us. You might even receive additional benefits like early access to builds and free keys for a Patrol Car DLC. Feel free to join us!

Cheers,
[b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: Here's a very special, undercover, and truly hunting announcement...
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nmTmm-UvqOQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Fellow officers,[/b]

Today, we have prepared some very exciting news to share with you, which will reveal some very special updates and projects that had been top-secret up until now.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nmTmm-UvqOQ][b]Watch today's On Patrol Episode further above to learn more![/b][/url]

And now, let's dive right into the news!

[h3]Time to go undercover...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/398b05e9171301483b2f1be0d6f20b3e43b7633b.jpg[/img]

Next Tuesday, on August 13, we will release the Unmarked and Special Vehicle Packs! These pack will include 8 skins in total, 4 of them as part of the Special Vehicle Pack which will give you new, extra fashionable patrol car skins plus a white ceremonial and a black special uniform for your officer!  

As part of the Unmarked Vehicle Pack, you receive 4 different skins for your patrol cars to patrol the city of Brighton completely in disguise! These go from a fun pizza delivery skin to a completely black livery kind of skin, so there is definitely a favorite for everyone! 

You don’t own any car DLC? No problem! These skin packs can be enjoyed by everyone who owns the DLCs, however only with the unmarked and the special liveries of the respective car.

The Unmarked & Special Vehicle Skin Pack will launch as paid DLC on August 13 on PC, Xbox & PlayStation! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893870/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Unmarked_Police_Vehicle_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893880/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Special_Police_Vehicle_Pack

[h3]That’s not all! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/c1092bebc93130f6e6ae90cc95bbd1d140971b9d.jpg[/img]

In addition to that, we will be launching a special update, also on August 13, introducing awesome, new outfits for your officers to the game on all platforms, completely for free for everyone! Go to the lockers in your precinct and select your favorite!  

This update also fixes a bunch of issues, including the one causing CP Loss when arresting someone for carrying an illegal weapon inside their car. The full changelog will be released alongside the update.

[h3]Let’s talk about this year’s gamescom! [/h3]

From August 21 to August 25, we will be once again at gamescom in Cologne, Germany.

On our booth, you can play the recently announced Nintendo Switch Edition which is currently developed at TurnMeUp Studios. If you haven’t known, you can already pre-order the edition on the Nintendo eShop and select retailers.  

At our booth, we will also host a showcase as part of a special livestream, where we will also announce even more exciting news for you! More details and the exact date will be shared next week.

[h3]The Police Simulator universe expands![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/0cbd0d2f2b33294322db09ed2ad28231c0e59be7.jpg[/img]

We're pleased to introduce Police Simulator – Prop Hunt: This new, very exciting entry is part of Fortnite Creative and is currently being developed by Independent Arts Studios. BTW, it will be playable completely for free!

Go on a hunt as an officer of the Police Department, equipped with your trusty flashlight and a useful weapon to catch other players who can disguise themselves as props for a limited amount of time. They can also roam the whole map to make out the best hiding places. You’ve spotted something moving as a hunter? Time to splat them!

notes.title: Highway Patrol Expansion: Thank you – and our Next Steps!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/a0e1471b51bd8096acb10c20c16cf5a570ddff33.jpg[/img]

[b]Fellow Officers,[/b]

The Highway Patrol Expansion has been out for more than a day now – and we hope you’re all enjoying your time on the fast lane! Thank you so much for your kind words but also the great amount of feedback across all our channels. We’ve been looking through it pretty much 24/7 since the official release and have been collecting all your comments while working on our next set of improvements.

First, we want to confirm that we are [b]working on an update[/b] that will introduce various improvements to the AI on the highway. We are aware that it is one of the most frequently feedbacked topics at the moment, which is why we put this high on our priority list. Here’s already a little work-in-progress sneak-peek from a build earlier today that displays current improvements to NPV AI behavior, especially when driving with the siren on:

[previewyoutube=2Rs6Y0hFDHI;full]
[/previewyoutube]
Beside minor bug fixes and other general improvements, we want to highlight following changes as well – please keep in mind that this list is [b]not complete[/b] and changes are possible based on our upcoming testing results:

[list]
[*]Improved lane switching AI on Highway when siren is activated
[*] Increased turn light strength
[*] Increased turn signal usage range on Highway
[*] Fixed Freeze when calling Arrest Transport on the Highway
[*] Fixed Injured NPC spawn rate being too low during Dynamic Accident Callouts
[*] Fixed parked NPV being in a wrong state
[*] Fixed soft lock occurring after issuing commercial driver ticket or verbal warning
[*] Fixed being unable to finish crime scenes on the Highway
[*] Fixed wrong body depending on character
[*] Fixed falsely assigned skin changes
[*] Fixed map cursor speed being too slow
[*] Fixed navigation on Highway Map UI appearing slightly off
[*] Fixed wanted NPV callout crash
[*] Fixed crash because of invalid debris
[/list]
Of course, you want to know [b]when the update will be released exactly[/b] – understandably so! Today, we will finish the merge of the respective builds while all our teams will start testing the fixes, improvements, and overall stability afterwards. Once that is done, the updates will be pushed into submission – this will take a few days until we receive all the necessary green lights. While we expect that to happen until the end of the week, an exact timing can only be shared once the approvals have been given. More details to follow!

Once again, it’s awesome to see how many of you enjoy the new features – please continue to share your feedback as we love hearing from you both what you love and also what you’d like to see being improved!

Last but not least, we also want to take the time to answer some of the most frequently asked questions:

[b]How many Duty Stars do I need to unlock the Highway?[/b]

You need at least 3 Duty Stars to receive access to the Highway District.

[b]How do I unlock the Highway District?[/b]

You have 3 Duty Stars? Perfect! Just finish a normal shift as usual – afterwards, the content of the Highway District will be unlocked and you will be able to start a shift on the Highway (either as a normal shift or in open patrol) right afterwards.

[b]Which bugs are you aware of?[/b]

We are actively investigating issues with AI, mismatching voice-overs, problems with character models, issues with license plates identification in multiplayer, crashes, multiplayer stability problems, arrest transport not arriving at the weigh stations, among others.

[b]How can I report bugs?[/b]

You can do this across [url=https://linktr.ee/policesimulator]all our channels[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/astragon]on our official Discord[/url], and right here on Steam. 

[h3]Thank you all and let’s continue our shift on the highway,

[b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Out now: The Highway Patrol Expansion!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=diI7X88Tb3Q;full][TRAILER][/previewyoutube]

The State of Franklin requires your attention, officers: Welcome to the [b]Highway Patrol Expansion[/b], now finally available for Police Simulator: Patrol Officers!🔥

For a limited time, you can still save 10% - so act fast!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350410/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Highway_Patrol_Expansion/

To celebrate the release accordingly, we’ve also created a huge sale for everyone who doesn’t own the game yet or still needs to complete their collection. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/astragon/sale/policesimulator?snr=1_5_9_][b]Save up to 35% for a very short time![/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/0b11c0bdf646ade4aded89af87194f75f401bb90.png[/img]
With the Highway Patrol Expansion, the area you’re serving will be greatly expanded: Your attention is no longer required solely in the inner city of Brighton, but now also on the vastly stretching highways surrounding the wider state of Franklin.

You won’t be patrolling just one highway; instead, there are multiple highways, all seamlessly integrated into the existing map. Exits at the border of Brighton lead you outside the city, while multiple interchanges with giant overpasses plus entrance and exit ramps connect the different highways with each other, enabling you to switch between them without interruptions.

From precincts on the highway to gas stations, motels, rest areas, and weigh stations – all these new places must be policed by you as a highway patrol officer.

[i]Note: 3 Duty Stars are required to unlock the Highway District.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/56987e6e8db82b59db821b3944eabb51cb8ae8fa.png[/img]
The highways surrounding Brighton offer new challenges as they are known for being fast-paced and eventful. That’s also why we’re finally introducing a long-awaited feature into the game: Intense highway chases are inevitable, and when fleeing suspects do not obey, requesting roadblocks, executing PIT maneuvers, utilizing the brand-new spike strips, and employing other strategies may become necessary. You can now also use your gun to order the fleeing driver to leave their car and surrender!

The highway also introduces other new dangers: The grand reopening has led to a concerning surge of car thefts, while drunk drivers pose an even greater risk to other users of the road. Larger accidents may include fires you must extinguish with the brand-new fire extinguisher, and scattered debris that you must pick up. After all, it’s your responsibility to ensure that not only the streets of Brighton but also the highways of Franklin are always safe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/dafa30703c58f4e041a204b4aea18f3103b845b7.png[/img]
The Highway Patrol Expansion will include two beautiful new patrol cars: The Interstate Police Vehicle might be a throwback to the past, but even in our modern present it will always look and feel cool. The Endurance Police Vehicle is an incredibly powerful SUV, tailored for pursuits and perfect for intercepting fleeing drivers, thanks to a heavy-duty device that can be used to stop fleeing vehicles at full speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/3d4d3233f9a7feb5fb03c260dae9cafd9a02dc30.png[/img]
One outfit can’t be enough, can it? With the Highway Patrol Expansion, you can finally change your uniforms right from the precinct. Head to the lockers and choose your favorite outfit to patrol the streets in style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/00c83e1c2b2bdbd7f606b195524a5162a90d04a2.png[/img]
Today’s release of the Highway Patrol Expansion is accompanied by a larger update with version number 14.0.7 – we’re introducing both a bunch of free new features and improvements that can be enjoyed by everybody as well as the content exclusive to owners of the DLC.

In preparation for the Highway Patrol Expansion, we’ve already overhauled the entire NPV lane switching behavior, letting the AI react smarter to your moves. In addition, car physics and damage models have been greatly improved, while new NPV designs have been added.

Within the City of Brighton, everyone will also be able to experience carnapping: NPCs can steal a car and drive away, which – should you observe that - might require you to stop them with a PIT maneuver as long as they’re still in your area of responsibility! That might not really be justified… but the option is there anyway. Have fun!

At car accident sites, debris can spawn that has to be picked up so that it won’t cause a danger for other road users. Make sure to remove every single bit – sometimes, you’ll even receive a callout just for that.

In addition, cars can now break down and become stranded at the side of the road. Not good! Make sure to assist the drivers, find out what’s wrong with the vehicle, and call for a tow truck.

We hope you’ll enjoy all features of both the Highway Patrol Expansion and the update itself – and now, off to the highway, officers!💥

[b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350410/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Highway_Patrol_Expansion?snr=2___

notes.title: Here’s what will be free with the release of the Highway Patrol Expansion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/2761c91311a4bc4d89886c185ccda2e7ffcaa03a.png[/img]

[b]Fellow Officers,[/b]

the Highway Patrol Expansion is coming closer and closer, and we really can’t wait for the release. While some things will obviously be only available for owners of the expansion, other things will be free for absolutely everybody owning the game. Today, we want to break this down in more detail to explain what you can expect on June 18 when the highway finally opens.

[h3]Coming for free for everybody[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/fbc1587ec2af137b395a4cc345a9f483ed8b8aa8.png[/img]

As you can imagine, the highway is always busy and also much faster than the inner city of Brighton. That’s why, in preparation for the release of the expansion, we overhauled the [i]entire[/i] car lane switching behavior to allow the AI to perform smarter moves. We also expanded the variety of NPC cars and added new designs. In addition, we improved car physics and overall damage models. Within the city, you can also sometimes observe NPCs unparking their cars!

During your daily shift on the streets of Brighton there’s now a good chance that you can witness someone trying to break into a car: [b][i]Carnapping is finally here[/i][/b]! NPCs can steal a car and drive away, requiring you to pursue and stop them. Maybe you should perform a [b][i]PIT maneuver[/i][/b]… yes, this is also new! And it looks cool. And it’s fun. Believe us.

Accident sites will require your attention even more now – after all, these cars take a lot of damage. [i]Debris[/i] will now spawn around the cars which you have to pick up and remove. Otherwise, they will pose a great danger to other cars! Sometimes, you will also receive a callout for that.

Cars can now also [i]break down and become stranded[/i] at the side of the road. Make sure to help the drivers, assist them, and call for a tow truck.

[h3]Exclusive to the Highway Patrol Expansion[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/6efed66535302942566fe285d0ce05b147cef4f3.png[/img]

This might seem obvious: Stuff that happens on the highway, stays on the highway. This, of course, includes [i]larger accidents[/i] on the highway (and they’re really large), sometimes requiring you to equip the [i]new fire extinguisher[/i].

More [b][i]advanced car chases[/i][/b] are also part of your duties, but a PIT maneuver isn’t your only option to stop them: You can also request [i]roadblocks[/i]! If you receive a callout that you need to support your colleagues, it’s your responsibility to set up a roadblock and [i]even spike strips[/i]. Other violations are also observable, for example drunk drivers. They might act quite suspiciously on the street… make sure to check them out.

The safety of other road users is of utmost importance – that’s why trucks (also new!) need to follow all rules. To make sure they do just that, trucks need to leave the highway to regularly perform a check at the[b] [i]weigh stations[/i][/b]. These will be manned by you: Check the trunk, make sure nothing illegal is being transported, inspect the papers and ensure they’re still within the legal weight limit.

There are also two new patrol cars, exclusive to owners of the expansion: The [i]Interstate Police Vehicle (IPV)[/i] and the [i]Endurance Police Vehicle (EPV)[/i]. You wanted an SUV, you’re getting an SUV. Isn’t that nice?

The entire highway itself is only available if you own the Highway Patrol Expansion. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/997010/announcements/detail/4208128169453337090]You can check out the full map here.[/url]

[h3]The highway is coming closer![/h3]

We have even more surprises around the Highway Patrol Expansion available for you, both at release and afterwards. Stay tuned for more!

The Highway Patrol Expansion will be available on June 18, 2024, for PC, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One at a price of 19.99€ / $19.99.

Pre-orders are available now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350410/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Highway_Patrol_Expansion/

For rookie officers, the new Gold Edition, which will launch at the same time, will include both the main game plus the Highway Patrol Expansion and the Garage Bundle. It will cost just 39.99€ / $39.99 or the regional equivalent on all available platforms. In select countries, the Gold Edition will be available in retail for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One at the same date and price.

notes.title: Introducing the brand-new areas in the Highway Patrol Expansion!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/ee051d094fa9238dbdb4ab4393c087ee6db3f583.png[/img]

[b]Fellow Officers,
[/b]With the upcoming Highway Patrol Expansion, the area you’re serving will be greatly expanded: Your attention is no longer required solely in the inner city of Brighton, but now also on the vastly stretching highways surrounding the wider state of Franklin.

You won’t be patrolling just one highway; instead, there are multiple ones, all seamlessly integrated into the existing map. Exits at the border of Brighton lead you outside the city, while multiple interchanges with giant overpasses plus entrance and exit ramps connect the different highways with each other, enabling you to switch between them without interruptions.

[h3]Wider Views[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/56ba42308d42fa213a59304ba7751217367bc9e1.png[/img][i]The new and expanded map, seamlessly integrated [/i]

While the City of Brighton is always busy and never resting, its suburban areas offer some fantastic views in an almost recreational, relaxing fashion. While the huge Swan House Lake with an impressive depth of 1135ft can be passed over via a large bridge, enormous trailer parks, sharp shorelines of the ocean, cozy farmhouses, powerful wind turbines, dense forests, suburban villages, and many other places can be observed right from the comfort of the roadway.

[h3]The New Precincts[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/c3c8ae2d11bc658790ff69a3f57237b7d85cebb9.jpg[/img]
Given the hectic and fast-paced nature of highway work, you, as an officer, will need an appropriate location to wind down. That’s why the Brighton Police Department has opened up new and large   precincts along the highway, perfectly suited for your next shift. Of course, they are also equipped with a handy garage and a sizeable parking lot!

In addition, smaller satellite precincts have been installed in strategically placed locations, for example at the weigh stations. If you decide to end your shift after a long day of checking on documents, you can choose this option as well!

[h3]From Diners to Motels[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/b4c1a8c54facf65e42446d7cf01d47ecc1a6b83a.jpg[/img]
When the citizens of Brighton embark on their next journey, they need to replenish their supplies on the go. Dustin’s Traditional Diner is an established institution all over the State of Franklin and their beautiful branches right on the highway surely worth a visit – and the same applies to the local chain of motels and the gas stations! Who knows, maybe you’ll spot an offense while you’re hanging out in the parking lot?

[h3]Duty at the Weigh Stations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/c21051cba5723f0d19eab979ab3ded6e2064a55c.jpg[/img]
At the weigh stations, you must investigate if all regulations are met by the truck drivers roaming around the highway.  Pick up the badge and inspect all papers, investigate the insides of the truck for potentially illegal items, make sure the weight limit   is not being exceeded, check out the driver, and more. Let’s hope everything’s fine and no one is trying to flee!

[h3]There’s something to see at every corner[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/06c270b56a6d584260a29cf79423e17359550849.jpg[/img]
Our goal was to make the highway as lively and vibrant as possible  – ensuring that you’ll discover new and exciting details with every shift. From construction sites at one place to a place for lunch at another, keep your eyes open as there’s a lot more to discover.

notes.title: Pick Up The Chase: Introducing The Highway Patrol Expansion!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=7p-ZWIx2PJE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Fellow Officers,[/b]

It’s time to increase the speed, explore the outskirts of Brighton, and elevate your responsibilities – welcome to the [b]Highway Patrol Expansion[/b], coming to Police Simulator: Patrol Officers this Summer!

Police Simulator will become bigger, better, faster. And today, we’re giving you a first look at what’s inside!

[h2]Brighton is growing![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/1ded29dc116a5e773301ded1593a6087ef5cf1d5.png[/img]
 
The Highway Patrol Expansion will extend both the jurisdiction of the Brighton Police Department and your duties as an ever-helpful patrol officer. As the name of the expansion so discreetly suggests, you will finally be able to leave the inner city and stroll on the vast highway that surrounds the entirety of Brighton to explore the wider State of Franklin.

With the expansion, the map will be[b] bigger than ever before[/b] – with entrance and exit ramps, overpasses, interchanges, and everything else you’d rightfully expect. From precincts at the highway to gas stations, motels, rest areas, and weigh stations – all these new places must be policed by you as a highway patrol officer.

[h2]Let’s speed things up![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/44ac6c791a3dbca29206df843ca15c5a6e71ebb9.jpg[/img]
 
The highways surrounding Brighton offer new challenges as they are known for being fast-paced and eventful. For the very first time, we’re introducing [b]car chases[/b] into the game: Intense highway chases are inevitable, and when fleeing suspects do not obey, requesting roadblocks, executing PIT maneuvers, utilizing the brand-new spike strips, and employing other strategies may become necessary. After all, the grand reopening of the highway also leads to a concerning surge of [b]car thefts[/b], while drunk drivers pose an even greater risk for other users of the road.

[b]The highway also introduces other new dangers:[/b] Larger accidents can include fires you must extinguish with the brand-new fire extinguisher, and scattered debris that you must pick up. After all, it’s your responsibility to ensure that not only the streets of Brighton but also the highways of Franklin are always safe!

[h2]Check the trucks, assist the drivers[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/c21051cba5723f0d19eab979ab3ded6e2064a55c.jpg[/img]
 
People need goods – and of course, they are brought from A to B by our incredible freight drivers! For safety reasons, several regulations exist which must be met by all drivers at all times. At the [b]weigh stations[/b], you have to investigate if the trucks are still within the legal limits – after all, there’s only so much a truck is allowed to transport. In addition, papers must be inspected, and the truck should be checked for potentially illegal items. 

Along the highway, several drivers will require your assistance. A broken-down car? Find out what’s going on! Someone is driving suspiciously? Make sure they’re not DUI! The citizens of Franklin will be thankful for your ongoing commitment. 

[h2]New cars to play and patrol with[/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/922acbe1c95c316e71dfe8b2630a5d04b31ee648.jpg[/img]

The Highway Patrol Expansion will include two beautiful new patrol cars: The [b]Interstate Police Vehicle[/b] might be a throwback to the past, but even in our modern present it will always look and feel cool. The [b]Endurance Police Vehicle[/b] is an incredibly powerful SUV, tailored for pursuits and perfect for intercepting fleeing drivers, thanks to a heavy-duty device that can be used to stop fleeing vehicles at full speed.

[h2]Something for everyone[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/c3c8ae2d11bc658790ff69a3f57237b7d85cebb9.jpg[/img]
 
With the Highway Patrol Expansion, we will introduce a bunch of free new features and improvements that can be enjoyed by everybody – [b]without[/b] having to own the DLC.

In preparation for the Highway Patrol Expansion, we’re overhauling the entire NPV lane switching behavior, letting the AI react smarter to your moves. In addition, car physics and damage models will also be greatly improved, while new NPV designs have been added.

Within the City of Brighton, everyone will also be able to experience carnapping: NPCs can steal a car and drive away, which – should you observe that - might require you to stop them with a PIT maneuver as long as they’re still in your area of responsibility!

At car accident sites, debris can spawn that has to be picked up so that it won’t cause a danger for other road users. Make sure to remove every single bit – sometimes, you’ll even receive a callout just for that.

In addition, cars can now break down and become stranded at the side of the road. Not good! Make sure to assist the drivers, find out what’s wrong with the vehicle, and call for a tow truck.

[h2]SAVE THE DATE: Exclusive gameplay reveal at PAX East![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/942669c16666de0e4c13188394bcb8ff3d5955de.png[/img]

During this year's PAX East from March 21 to 24 in Boston, you will be able to experience the Highway Patrol Expansion for yourself! Get your hands on the latest build at the astragon Entertainment booth (booth 16105).

For everyone at home, we have something very special planned: [b]On March 23rd from 4:00 to 5:00pm EST, we will host an exclusive livestream right from the PAX Showfloor.[/b] At the astragon PAX Showcase panel, we will reveal [i]never-seen-before[/i] gameplay from the Highway Patrol Expansion and show it in all its glory. The livestream will be joined by a very special guest: Police Simulator fan and simulation expert Raptor who will also host the stream on his channel!

Make sure to bookmark the stream already:

[previewyoutube=5REFxadBxAA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]More details are coming soon![/h2]

For rookie officers, the new Gold Edition, which will launch at the same time, will include both the main game plus the Highway Patrol Expansion and the Garage Bundle. It will cost just 39.99€ / $39.99 or the regional equivalent on all available platforms.  In select countries, the Gold Edition will be available in retail for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One at the same date and price.

The Highway Patrol Expansion will be available in Summer 2024 for PC, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One at a price of 19.99€ / $19.99.

Pre-orders are available now for PC on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350410/

More details about the Highway Patrol Expansion, the exact release date, and additional official pre-order information will be shared in the coming weeks!

[b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: The First Aid Update is out now!⛑️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/95d6075240d4fc54b6761fa0e44590a3132a49d3.jpg[/img]
Officers, there has been an accident!

Hurry to the site and treat individuals in need: [b]The First Aid Update is now available on all platforms! [/b] 

The highlight of this update features the new content addition “First Aid” along with numerous enhancements to improve your playing experience! Furthermore, we have released a brand new DLC vehicle lighting up the city at night! Let’s dive right into it! 


[h2]Perform First Aid on patients! 🩹 [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/0e0f79c738afe44739fb8c70f6aef580d98294d2.jpg[/img]
[b]The injured require your assistance![/b] When arriving at a major accident scene and encountering injured people, the proper approach of the situation is crucial. Take care of patients by performing first aid and interview them about the accident! This update gives you the opportunity to not only gather witness testimonies but to perform essential first aid, stabilize their condition and prepare them for transport to the hospital by the medical professionals. For balancing purposes, the first aid feature is only available upon receiving 7 duty stars in district 2.

[b]Let me treat your injuries![/b] In order to properly treat the patients, you need to be aware of their current health conditions. These include: slightly injured, critically injured and being unconscious, and critically injured and being in a state of cardiac arrest. Treat slightly injured people by applying bandages and interview them as accidents witnesses afterwards to gain more information on the accident!  

Critically injured patients are not available for verbal interaction since they are not responsive in their condition. Furthermore, distinct treatments are necessary for critically injured patients to stabilize them effectively: Accident victims that are unconscious are taken care of by only applying bandages and calling the medics for assistance, since they do not require CPR! For patients being in a state of cardiac arrest, the top priority is to administer CPR promptly in order to resuscitate them!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/23671ea051073cb47ffe8e1bf70ada86003ca5d0.jpg[/img] 
[b]You’re not dying on me![/b] To perform CPR on an injured person you must be precise and effective! Engage in a minigame featuring a pattern on an action line, requiring exact timing to hit the action button within a defined threshold to earn points! Gather a sufficient number of points to successfully complete the minigame and stabilize the patient. Once this condition is achieved, further treatment with bandages can be done! If the CPR attempt is unsuccessful, the injured person will lose consciousness while still regaining their breath.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/f2ebd13e27eda2c746aee6d76ec4fbc93955eb24.png[/img]

[b]This patient should be carried on a stretcher:[/b] Mark the injured for dismissal once they have been properly treated, their condition has been stabilized and you have completed any feasible accident interviews with slightly injured patients! The medical team, which now consists of 2 medics, can carry patients on a stretcher and will come to your assistance as soon as the patients have been marked. Up to 3 injured people can be transported to the hospital by the ambulance at once!  


[h2]Enhancing your quality-of-life 💜[/h2] 

In order to improve your overall experience of the game, we also set a focus in this update on bug fixes, gameplay adjustments and performance optimizations. To mention a few, you will several fixes for unjustified CP loss issues, improved NPV behavior across the board, fixed multiple crashes, and resolved multiple graphical problems. Alongside other balancing adjustments, we increased the number of tool slots available for each patrol vehicle and defined a useful default loadout.

As mentioned, we have greatly improved performance all over the game. You should now experience way less frame drops, frame hitches, and stutters - while also enjoying increased FPS and improved visuals.

Have a look at the complete changelog at the end of this posting for further details!

As we are aware that there are still issues that need to be resolved, we are constantly working on resolving these and will implement more bug fixes and adjustments in future updates! Always feel free to report bugs and issues to our team on Discord or in the Steam forums! Yes, we read every single comment. Pinky promise.
 
[h2]Bright at night 💡 The Warden Police Vehicle DLC (WPV) [/h2]

[previewyoutube=n0zHxglth08;full]https://youtu.be/n0zHxglth08[/previewyoutube]
Easily patrol the streets of Brighton at night with the new night shift police special vehicle! 

Effectively communicate with people using the roads during nighttime via an [b]illuminating two-sided lightbar[/b] on the special car’s roof, which allows to convey different text messages significantly more intuitively in the dark, enabling easier handling of accidents, traffic issues and violations.

Secure accidents effortlessly by building a road barrier for NPVs being on the same road with displaying the text message “ACCIDENT”, ward off NPVs from passing by using the term “DO NOT PASS” and prompt another vehicle to pull over by communicating “PULL OVER” when positioned in front of a car. However, the lightbar feature can only be used effectively in the dark of the night! To additionally support the visibility around the vehicle, the WPV is further equipped with an underglow light for optimal securing of any scene! 

The Warden Police Vehicle is purchasable now at a small price of 2,99€ / $2,99 USD or the equivalent in your region. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527830/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Warden_Police_Vehicle_DLC/

[h2]Welcome to The Garage Bundle[/h2]

The Garage Bundle now also includes the Warden Police Vehicle! If you own some of the cars already, you can profit from a discount on other vehicles - including the WPV. What a deal!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36438/Police_Simulator_Garage_Bundle/
 
[h2]The complete changelog✨: [/h2] 

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Introducing First Aid
- Injured NPCs now come with two different degrees of injury: Slight and critical injuries
- Players are now able to provide first aid to injured NPCs
- Players can now apply bandages to NPCs
- Players can now perform CPR on unconscious NPCs as part of a special minigame
[*] Now, there are two medics arriving with the emergency vehicle
[*] Medics can now carry a stretcher to transport critically injured NPCs
[*] Introducing the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527830/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Warden_Police_Vehicle_DLC/]Warden Police Vehicle (WPV)[/url], now available as an optional DLC
[*] Introducing a skin changing option for patrol car mods inside the garage. This means that you can now install multiple patrol car skins from the Steam Workshop and they won't override each other anymore. You can therefore now have multiple mods active and select individual skins per car.
[/list]
[b]Performance[/b]

[/list] 
[b]Balancing[/b]

[*] Defined a useful default loadout for each patrol vehicle
[/list] 
[b]Traffic Cars[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

notes.title: The First Aid Update is coming on March 12!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/2a882fb377af6de58614efc0d974d08627e4dda4.jpg[/img]

Officers! It’s time to save lives!

Rush to the accident scene and help injured people: [b]The First Aid Update is coming on March 12 to all platforms! [/b]

This update mainly focuses on the new content feature “First Aid” and a whole lot of quality-of-life improvements. Let’s look at the details!


[h2]The injured require First Aid!⛑️[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/0e0f79c738afe44739fb8c70f6aef580d98294d2.jpg[/img]

[b]You encounter a major accident with injured people?[/b] Take care of the patients, perform first aid and save lives! Not only will you have to gather witness testimonies, but with the upcoming update, you’ll also need to provide essential first aid  and call medical professionals to take them to the hospital once their condition has been stabilized! This feature will unlock upon achieving 7 duty stars in district 2 for balancing purposes. 

[b]How are you feeling?[/b] The accident patients you will encounter can be in three different health states: slightly injured, critically injured and being unconscious, and critically injured and being in a state of cardiac arrest. Slightly injured NPCs can be treated by applying bandages, after which they can be interviewed as accident witnesses. Critically injured patients will not be responsive and will therefore not be available for verbal interaction. The patients being critically injured also must be treated differently, as unconscious patients do not require CPR and would be taken care of by applying bandages and calling the medics for assistance. Patients being in a state of cardiac arrest need to be resuscitated by performing CPR on them as the top priority! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/23671ea051073cb47ffe8e1bf70ada86003ca5d0.jpg[/img]

[b]Save a life![/b] Perform CPR and engage in a minigame featuring a pattern on an action line, requiring precise timing within the defined threshold to earn points. A successful completion of the minigame by accumulating a sufficient number of points will stabilize the patient, allowing further treatment with bandages. A failed CPR attempt here results in the patient losing consciousness while still regaining their breath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/579e6634ba2cbc3f8f808f998b3cac3a9ce53680.jpg[/img]

[b]Did someone call for an ambulance?[/b] As soon as you have performed first aid and finished any possible interviews with the patients, proceed to mark them for dismissal and request assistance from the medical team, which now consists of two medics, who can carry the patients on a stretcher. An ambulance will be able to transport  up to 3 patients at once, that have been marked before.  


[h2]Quality of Life Improvements🫀[/h2]

In addition to introducing new content, we will also be implementing a bunch of bug fixes, performance optimizations and gameplay adjustments. Among others, these include a fix for large police vehicles struggling to get out of the garage at Bannock Station, resolving some unjustified CP loss issues and a fix for the inability to greet NPCs in a new game’s first shift. Furthermore, we will increase the number of tool slots available for each patrol vehicle and define a useful default loadout, alongside others balancing adjustments. The complete changelog will be revealed in the release posting on March 12!

As it is a high priority for us to improve the overall quality of the game, we are always working on more quality-of-life improvements to incorporate into future updates.


[h2]Safety at night: The Warden Police Vehicle DLC(WPV)💡[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/70d87ca646681fa7cf2c8cbd4af9c8862a9aecf9.jpg[/img]
Light up the nights of Brighton with the new illuminating police vehicle!

With the extraordinary addition of a [b]two-sided lightbar[/b] on top of the vehicle, featuring the capability to display different messages, effectively communicating with NPCs during nighttime will become significantly more intuitive and effective!

notes.title: The Tackling Update is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/0145e8b480e83e7c52b9a21c5e0bc1b5ddd1f1f1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Officers! Action is awaiting you! 🔥 [/h3]

Put your skills into action and capture fleeing suspects: [b]The Tackling Update has been released for Police Simulator: Patrol Officers across all platforms![/b]

This update primarily focuses on the new tackling feature, the new minimap for foot patrols and quality-of-life improvements to enhance your overall gaming experience! Let's have a look at the details:

[h2]The suspect is getting away![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/36d5b2de32e1d382a07877a8d53a15e5a5f668f3.jpg[/img]
[b]Make a choice![/b] The new action-packed feature introduces another option for catching a fleeing suspect, offering increased versatility and autonomy in these situations. Tackling presents a more challenging alternative to tasing a suspect, infusing a fresh sense of interaction into the gameplay.

[b]Training is key![/b] When an officer may need to resort to physical force, proper training and experience are required. Police tackling a fleeing criminal is a highly perilous und critical situation that demands careful handling, considering the unique nature of each individual incident.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/fcec57f7d04fbda42288c793ba5812cb91b35965.png[/img]

[b]How to take action?[/b] To tackle a fleeing suspect, you will be prompted with a button while running and when in close proximity to the suspect. Use this button prompt to forcefully bring the target to the ground and restrain them with handcuffs before they have a chance to escape! It is crucial for the safety of both involved parties and their environment to select an area with sufficient room and only approach the individual from either behind or from the side. 

[h2]Minimap on foot patrol 🗺️[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/a4d1f146be74998e3be4f02896ba34259e8c5928.png[/img]
[b]You're getting lost easily?[/b] We got you covered, introducing the minimap on foot patrol! With this new feature, you will be able to effortlessly navigate your surroundings, locate destinations and move around with enhanced efficiency and intuitive ease!

[h2]Quality improvements[/h2]

In order to enhance your overall playing experience of the game, we have implemented a multitude of bug fixes and improvements! These include the removal of the sun glare screen, the rectification of unreasonable CP loss, the fixing of unpleasant flashing lights within the precinct at the start of the game and the resolution of an issue that provided incorrect feedback regarding illegal item intuition. 

Take a look at the official changelog at the end of this post for a full overview! 

Rest assured, we are continuously working on further improvements to enrich your life as a patrol officer!

Watch the Release Trailer for the Tackling Update here:
[previewyoutube=wuZ6Q_eAB7g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Now available: The newest generation of vehicles 🚔[/h2]

We're happy to release two new vehicle DLCs! Explore the exciting features of both to keep Brighton safe and sound:

[h3]The Guardian Police Vehicle [GPV][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/5483a7fd3725649e4eba24bc348289f8ded46191.jpg[/img]
A [b]spacious and practical choice[/b] for a great police officer.

This new innovation vehicle allows you to personally transport up to 6 arrested criminals to the police station. Earn +10 SP for each prisoner you successfully transported and locked in their cells, with the reward doubled when delivering 6 criminals simultaneously. 

[previewyoutube=vDa6kPKVSe0;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2210960/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Guardian_Police_Vehicle_DLC

[h3]The Surveillance Police Vehicle [SPV][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/b90136a2e59b98e6f8b5dc2caed2bde90b5eb5c4.png[/img]
A [b]versatile choice[/b] to support you at [b]observing[/b] the streets of Brighton!

Presenting a state-of-the-art additon to the police vehicle force that revolutionizes the detection of violations. By closely following a suspicious target vehicle, the SPV provides intuition feedback to the driver. Operating similar to pacing, it fills a colored bar in the same position. Once a violation is detected, you can pull over the target vehicle and conduct a complete investigation of the suspect. 

[previewyoutube=oYB5HD-g3Ss;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527820/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Surveillance_Police_Vehicle_DLC

The GPV and the SPV are purchasable each at a small price of 2,99€ / $2,99 USD or the equivalent in your region.

[h2]Modding Support for both vehicles!🖌️[/h2]

[b]Personal creations thrill you?[/b] Then this is for you!

Modding is supported for both the GPV and the SPV and gives you the ability to create your own customizations for the vehicles! Personalise your police vehicles now and share your modifications with us and the rest of the community! We are eager to see what you have already created for the new vehicles, since the modding kit was updated on the day of the update announcement!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2778896763

[h2]Are you ready for more details? [/h2]

Momentarily, our primary focus is on delivering quality improvements and resolving bugs, which is why we have made the decision to move first aid to update 13. This allows us to assign more resources towards addressing current issues and ensuring more bug fixes in the upcoming months. 

But for now, let's take a good look at the official [b]changelog[/b] of this update:

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an option to tackle fleeing NPCs
[*] Added a minimap to foot patrol
[*] Introducing the new Surveillance Police Vehicle (SPV), now available as an optional DLC
[*] Introducing the new Guardian Police Vehicle (GPV), now available as an optional DLC
[*] Introducing Modding Support for the SPV and GPV
[/list]
[b]Callouts[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the Transport Arrestee Callout to become an Emergency Callout, now allowing the use of sirens
[/list] 
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted wording for Drug Dealer Callouts
[/list] 
[b]Crash Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred within a drug dealer callout
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred after declining a drug dealer callout
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred after placing a tool and switching to a different car
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred after entering the garage and switching to a different car
[*] Fixed a crash that was related to crime scene evidence
[/list]
-------------

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Traffic Stops to be generated in a wrong way
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Traffic Stop callouts to be proposed to a player when no parking spot is available on that street, resulting in a non-working callout
[*] Fixed an issue that caused unjustified CP Loss for towing illegaly parked cars with the MPV on sidewalks
[*] Fixed an issue that caused unjustified CP Loss for a drug dealing charge
[*] Fixed an issue that caused placed items to disappear when going too far away and not teleport back into the trunk
[*] Fixed illegal item intuition being triggered when none exist
[*] Added Injury as a reason to finish the Wanted NPC Callout
[*] Fixed an issue with Traffic Stop callouts being proposed even if no parking spots are found resulting in a broken callout scenario
[*] Fixed an issue with drug dealers not running away when being observed drug dealing
[*] Fixed an issue with passive emergency callouts not amounting to emergency callouts
[/list] 
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused everything to be much brighter for the host as soon as the client joined the precinct
[*] Fixed missing icons and labels on the maps for the client
[*] Fixed an issue that enabled the MPV to tow a car that is being towed by a tow truck at the very same time in multiplayer
[*] Fixed an issue with players owning different kinds of DLC
[*] Fixed an issue with clients not being able to use the garage
[/list] 
[b]Patrol Car / Traffic Car[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bunch of cases where the player will be launched into the air while driving their patrol car
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the lightbar on top of patrol car vehicles to appear invisible
[*] Fixed additional cases causing taxis to leave behind appendages
[*] Fixed an issue that let parked cars near crime scenes block access to multiple areas
[*] Fixed an issue that caused NPVs to quickly change direction, potentially causing accidents with the player
[*] Fixed an issue that turned underglow lights on after fining
[/list] 
[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the sun glare screen after lots and lots of feedback
[*] Fixed the really bad flashing lights inside the precinct when starting the game
[*] Fixed some other lighting issues within the precinct
[/list] 
[b]Game World[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a floating plant box near the bakery in Brianna (thanks, Beaver)
[*] Adjusted the collision of securing tapes at crime scenes
[*] Fixed an issue with crime scene evidence being placed in areas where you can not photograph them
[/list] 
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that showed wrong illegal item intuition feedback
[*] Fixed the description of the MPV and the UTV when they have been unlocked
[*] Fixed an issue with no text being visible in key bindings for computer group
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/

[h3]We hope you love the update!✨[/h3]

[i]Your Police Simulator Team[/i]

notes.title: The Tackling Update is coming on December 5th, 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/6d31625d174c78d9393331f2f921725f7f63bf4e.jpg[/img]
[h3]Officers! It’s time for action! 🔥[/h3]

Get your body into action and stop that fleeing suspect: [b]The Tackling Update is coming on December 5th, 2023, to Police Simulator: Patrol Officers across all platforms![/b]
With this update, we focus mainly on tackling, a minimap on foot patrol and quality-of-life improvements to overall enhance your playing experience. Let's jump into it!

[h2]Officer, the suspect is fleeing![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/f52e22eb8b7b35dafb9b6abd22d61a21900e23b8.png[/img]
[b]Tase or tackle?[/b] With the new tackling option, catching a fleeing suspect becomes way more versatile due to different options in handling the situation. The feature presents a more challenging way to interact with NPCs, bringing you closer to the action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/4db4235222bf0afd02c0f3207a892a4c5ccd4dec.png[/img]
[b]Let's get to training![/b] Police tackling a fleeing criminal is a critical and dangerous situation that requires a well-trained and experienced police officer! Every situation is different and must be handled cautiously, particularly when an officer may need to resort to physical force.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/4b27b10e80c1cefebc4c2f20967f131bc3164533.png[/img]
[b]Call to action![/b] To tackle a suspect, start running, get in close range with the fleeing person and in line of sight to get a button prompt. Use the button to tackle the target to the ground and handcuff them before they escape! Due to safety reasons, an officer is only allowed to tackle a person from behind or from the side, which will also detain them automatically. Make sure to always choose a place with enough space to be able to safely tackle a criminal!

[h2]Minimap on foot patrol[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/a4d1f146be74998e3be4f02896ba34259e8c5928.png[/img]
Getting lost easily? We got you, with the new minimap on foot patrol! With this new feature, you will be able to easily find places and get around more efficiently and intuitively!

[h2]Quality improvements[/h2]

To improve your overall playing experience in the game, we made numerous improvements and fixes! Among others we have removed the sun glare screen, have rectified unreasonable CP loss, fixed the unpleasant flashing lights inside the precinct when starting the game and fixed an issue that showed wrong illegal item intuition feedback!
Of course, we’re always working on further improvements to enhance your life as a patrol officer!

[h2]Introducing: The newest generation of vehicles 🚔[/h2]

We're happy to announce two new DLCs! Explore the amazing advantages of both to keep Brighton safe and sound:

[h3]The Guardian Police Vehicle (GPV)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/098b06093ac4d2a35c9279f286ae4bd120021624.png[/img]
A spacious and handy choice for a great police officer! 
With this new generation vehicle, you will be able to transport up to 6 arrested criminals and drive them to the police station yourself! Earn +10 SP for each prisoner you successfully transported and put in their cells, with the reward doubled when transporting 6 prisoners simultaneously.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2210960/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Guardian_Police_Vehicle_DLC

[h3]The Surveillance Police Vehicle (SPV)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/b90136a2e59b98e6f8b5dc2caed2bde90b5eb5c4.png[/img]
A versatile choice to support you at observing the streets of Brighton!
This cutting-edge addition to the police vehicle force will detect violations by simply following a suspicious target vehicle and giving its driver intuition feedback. It works similar to pacing and fills another colored bar in the same position. When a violation is uncovered, you can pull over the target vehicle and further investigate the suspect.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527820/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Surveillance_Police_Vehicle_DLC
The GPV and the SPV will both be released on December 5th, 2023 alongside the update, each at a small price of 2,99€ / $2,99 USD or the equivalent in your region.

[h2]Modding Support for both vehicles, starting today! 🖌️[/h2]

You love your own style? Then this is for you! 
Modding is supported for both the GPV and the SPV and gives you the ability to create your own customizations for the vehicles! The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2782471905&requirelogin=true]modding kit[/url] is already updated today, so you can dive into the work with a heads-up!  

Create your very own look and impress us with your creativity! 

[h2]Hang in there for more news![/h2]

With The Tackling Update, we will also publish the full patch notes, so you can see the full extent of the improvements.

Once again, there will be content creators receiving full access to the update prior to the release date while it is still in submission for the public release. Their ability to showcase might give you a chance to take a sneak peek at the content, so stay tuned!

At the moment, we want to focus on quality improvements and bug fixes and have therefore moved first aid to update 13 while ensuring more bug fixes now and in the upcoming months.

We hope you’re excited about the new features and improvements coming on December 5th! Thank you so much for your support!

[i]Your Police Simulator Team[/i]

notes.title: The Crime Scene Update is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/588bdfdefb9a57c57fffb6e7cb26717fe12d2ef1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Patient officers👮‍♂️, [/h2]

your wait is no longer! Rush to the scene now and make sure the evidence is safely secured: [b]The Crime Scene Update[/b] is now waiting for you across all platforms! Oh, and we're now also Steam Deck verified!

You can now enjoy the highly requested crime scene improvements and be more involved in resolving crimes than ever before…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/49f92147546a2d7cac128236a025b5b664ab5188.jpg[/img]
 
So far, as an officer you have been given a rather shallow approach to solving a crime scene in either knowing or not knowing about the suspect's identity. That changes now with the new Crime Scene Update giving you greater responsibilities and advanced, versatile tasks. 

[b]Officers, we are in need of your skills...[/b]

During “Car Patrols” you can get new and advanced crime scene callouts and are made directly responsible for the initial procedures and safety assurance as the first responder arriving at the scene.

[h3]Poles & Tapes⚠️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/f6f951dc258df8f475c448ce33e679b5d3843a1e.jpg[/img]

Stop right there, this is a crime scene! Creating a safe environment is a crucial element of police duty. With the new securing poles you now have a practical assistant on hand to secure a crime scene properly to prohibit potential compromise of evidence and calm down the scene for potential victims.

In terms of placing they are similar to cones: You can place them at the desired location on the ground by a simple button press while holding them in your hands. Tape automatically connects the poles you place, allowing you to keep the uninvolved away from the crime scene.

But how are the crime scenes visible in the dark? Wait.. is there something shiny back there? That’s right! Securing poles are reflecting light during the night for the sake of safety.

From the trunk of your patrol car you can access the poles and tapes and add them to your inventory when engaging a crime scene. Via the garage you can also assign them to the trunk itself!

[h3]Preserve the evidence🧬🔍[/h3]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/c97a9437940f64c59dabdb6690a0804fd4fdcda9.jpg[/img]

Our environment can tell us many things about the stories that people are involved in. Just as people leave traces, a crime scene can offer all kinds of different hints on what might have happened or what caused the incident. 

As a police officer it is your responsibility to preserve, mark and document every piece of evidence that can be later used in court by other law enforcement agencies. Meaning, you play an important role in solving the crimes, of which crime scenes you investigate.

The brand-new evidence markers are assisting you with marking the evidence with numbers by being placed next to each item on the ground. To document these items you simply need to take photographs which are then advancing the progression at the scene. These photographs though have to be taken before any kind of change or interaction with the scene to not distort the evidence.

In order to find the suspect responsible for the crime you need to gather as much information as possible at the crime scene through documenting and investigating. You will quickly realize that a solid gathering of information is the key to finding, arresting and transporting the suspect successfully.

[b]Experience the new update in our release trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=QHgvNZj58ls;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Now available: The Multipurpose Police Vehicle🚓🚨[/h3]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/3cd1d9d4d729680e9b7f9c52cf140315d92a35c6.jpg[/img]

Explore a new feeling of police car driving with the sturdy and practical Multipurpose Police Vehicle (MPV)!

The brilliant next-generation police vehicle allows you to move civilians’ vehicles violating the law or which are damaged from an accident while also increasing the size of your trunk inventory.

For a small price of 2,99€ / $2,99 USD or the equivalent in your region you can claim the Multipurpose Police Vehicle for Brighton’s safety now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2513250/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Multipurpose_Police_Vehicle_DLC/

[previewyoutube=eBT8HPK1X7c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Steam Deck is now supporting Police Business! ✅[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/63b3f2a5e485a5bae30088173df1cd95cdb6565f.png[/img]

Keep the streets of Brighton safe with full compatibility on Steam Deck with build-in controls and display! Police Simulator: Patrol Officers is now officially... verified ✅

[h3]Are you ready for a crime scene?🔦[/h3]

We can't wait to hear what you think about the new crime scene investigation and look forward to share more details about the next update, focusing on first aid among other features! 👀

Well, then let's take a look at the official changelog for today's update!

notes.title: The Crime Scene Update is coming on October 19, 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/cc07e39218e20382d36b3b458e6f9cb9105c49f1.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
activate your sirens, rush to the scene and ensure evidence is secured: [b]The Crime Scene Update is coming on October 19, 2023 to Police Simulator: Patrol Officers across all platforms![/b]

With this update, we focus entirely on improved crime scenes which have been highly requested by players. Let's dive right into it!

[h2]Officers, we require your assistance...[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/4a755b40a66cc63ef746b36e175f1eabbd9c29ec.jpg[/img]
A robbery? An assault? Up until now, the process of approaching a crime scene has been rather straightforward. You arrive, interview a witness and either you know who the suspect is, or you don't – and if you do, it's time to look out for the wanted suspect.

With The Crime Scene Update, your responsibilities will grow and your tasks will advance: With the new and advanced crime scene callouts, which can appear during 'Car Patrols', you are directly responsible for the safety and initial procedures as the first responder arriving at the scene.

[h3]Poles & Tapes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/cdbaeb5668fa0bdb16de37d09ed1190788090f8b.jpg[/img]
No trespassing allowed! To create a safer environment for all involved parties, especially potential victims, and to prohibit potential compromise of evidence, you must properly secure the crime scene. To assist you in this task, we're adding a new tool: Securing poles!

Placing the poles is fairly similar to cones: When holding them in your hands, it's just a simple button press to put them at the desired location on the ground. If you then place another pole nearby, a tape will automatically connect these poles, creating a barrier for NPCs who will now actively avoid the crime scene. Possibly the best way to keep the pertinent evidence uncontaminated, we would say.

You love [i]shiny[/i] stuff? Yeah, so do we. That's why securing poles will reflect light during night shifts, all for the sake of safety! And because it looks cool. But please don't tell our bosses.

Poles and tapes can be accessed and added to your inventory via the trunk of your patrol car. You can of course assign them to the trunk itself via the garage!

[h3]Secure the evidence[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/28a4ac200304e9d280c33247df9eb2e095b2ce72.jpg[/img]
Every crime scene tells a little story through its environment: What could possibly have happened here? Who was responsible for the mess? And why can't they just leave this little food stand alone, ffs?! Before you start your investigation, you are fully in the dark.

Your job is to help other law enforcement agencies to solve crimes by providing them with evidence that can later be used in court. That's why you need to secure, mark and document the evidence so that other parties can proceed with their work.

In your trunk, alongside the new poles, you will also discover brand-new evidence markers which can be placed next to each item on the ground. They will then be marked with a number and must be photographed with your camera, with each picture advancing the progression at the scene. This is important for your colleagues in Brighton as these photographs have to be taken before anything is touched, moved, or otherwise further investigated. The first shot of the evidence is very essential to confirm that no one has meddled with the crime scene, after all.

Here's what's cool: The more you progress with the documentation and associated investigation, the more information about the person responsible for the crime you receive! This will greatly help you during your search for the wanted suspect you need to find, arrest and transport in conclusion.

[h2]Introducing: The Multipurpose Police Vehicle[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/3cd1d9d4d729680e9b7f9c52cf140315d92a35c6.jpg[/img]
We're pleased to announce the [b]Multipurpose Police Vehicle (MPV)[/b], a solid and sturdy choice for your next shift!

The Multipurpose Police Vehicle is the perfect next-generation police vehicle to keep Brighton safe! Not only does this car allow you to tug away civilian vehicles damaged in accidents or which are violating the law, it also increases the size of your trunk inventory.

The Multipurpose Police Vehicle will release on October 19, 2023 alongside the update at a small price of just 2,99€ / $2,99 USD or the equivalent in your region.

[h2]Stay tuned for more news![/h2]

Of course, we'll ship a lot more improvements, bug fixes and adjustments with The Crime Scene Update. We'll publish the full patch notes for the update on October 19, 2023.

The first streamers and content creators will receive full access to the update in the coming days and will be able to showcase the new features prior to release while the update is still in submission for a public release on all platforms. This way, you can already take a look at the content!

Thank you all for your support and we hope you're excited for the full update once it launches on October 19.

[b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/abfca6d82dbc732f12759cfec44dd117707e783c.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
Today, we’re happy to finally release [b]The Garage Update[/b], now available to all players of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/][b]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/b][/url]! 

If you missed our last announcement post, here’s a recap of what to expect in this update:

[h2]The Garage 🏢[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/40b41c149ffcd705fd29a669379ecf0c4fc57090.jpg[/img]
The police garage expands all precincts of the Brighton PD and serves as the main hub for each car patrol shift.

[h3]Parking Lot Management 🅿️[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/4e7a816700daef35acd1f1e88b455d5b1a1f4cbd.jpg[/img]
Manage the precinct’s parking lot: Four parking spots are available at each precinct, and you can adjust every single one of them. You have a favorite patrol car and want it to be the default patrol car of the PD? Just fill up all spots with the same model! You prefer to have some variety? Select different ones. [b]The choice is yours.[/b]

[h3]Tool Management 🧰[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/5226a4043c4926281b003b2aa5a022c3008a9b12.jpg[/img]
Each patrol car has a specific capacity for carrying tools and that amount varies from model to model. Now you can freely decide which ones you want to bring along. Fill your trunk up however you want and assign the tools of your choice to the respective slots. You can even select the same tool in all slots.

[h3]Repair your Patrol Cars 🛠️[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/3305ca18f3aa7267b2bf3c12af430e6024c6cd49.jpg[/img]
You had an accident? In the past, your patrol car was either slightly or even completely wrecked in the aftermath. That sucks! :(

But now, you can repair them in the middle of the shift and don't need to wait for the next one. You can either repair them quickly with the press of a button when standing in front of the garage, or do it inside. 

[h2]Car Balancing ⚖️[/h2] 

We completely overhauled all the patrol vehicles and improved controls across the board. Please let us know what you think!

Should you own the CPV, you gain access to it from your very first shift, even on foot patrols! This Compact Police Vehicle is authorized for driving in parks and along narrow streets, allowing you to move throughout Brighton quickly while ensuring law and order are always respected. Due to its adorable size, it also serves as an excellent photo opportunity for the city's tourism industry!

The Compact Police Vehicle is available at a small price of just 2,99€ / $2,99 USD or the equivalent in your region:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2199030/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers_Compact_Police_Vehicle_DLC/

[previewyoutube=cHgydkzgtlI;full][/previewyoutube]

Enough talking, now it’s time for you to get back on patrol in the streets of Brighton! Thank you for all your support and we hope you enjoy the new update 🫶 In the meantime, we’ll continue working on Update 11, The Crime Scene Investigation Update… 🕵
