notes.title: The Garage Update is coming on July 18, 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/1f29422428aa6168975254837b16c91145af2b13.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
check your calendars and mark the date in red and bold: [b]The Garage Update is coming on July 18, 2023 to Police Simulator: Patrol Officers on all platforms![/b]

This update is all about the patrol cars: We received a lot of feedback in recent years concerning the handling of patrol cars, both in terms of driving behavior and how to manage them. Let's dive right into the details!

[h2]The Garage[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/40b41c149ffcd705fd29a669379ecf0c4fc57090.jpg[/img]
The precincts of the Brighton PD are expanding: [b]A garage can now be found at each precinct in the city[/b] and obviously they're not just cosmetic! Instead, they serve as the main hub to make each car patrol shift a little bit more comfy.

Once you approach a garage, you can enter them with the simple click of a button. Here the real fun begins.

[h3]Parking Lot Management[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/4e7a816700daef35acd1f1e88b455d5b1a1f4cbd.jpg[/img]
Previously, you only had access to a single patrol car of each model stationed at the parking lot right in front of the precinct. Now, you have full control over which and how many patrol cars you want to have there!

Four parking spots are available at each precinct and you can adjust every single one of them. You have a favorite patrol car and want it to be the default patrol car of the PD? Just fill up all spots with the same model! You prefer to have some variety? Select different ones. You only want to have one patrol car parked there? Just keep the other spots empty. [b]The choice is yours.[/b]

[h3]Tool Management[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/5226a4043c4926281b003b2aa5a022c3008a9b12.jpg[/img]
Each patrol car has a specific capacity for carrying tools and that amount varies from model to model. Now you can freely decide which ones you want to bring along.

Take just one with you. Fill your trunk up however you want and assign the tools of your choice to the respective slots. You can even select the same tool in all slots.

Not to forget: You can customize each car in a different way! [b]Whether you want to fill up one with traffic cones and others with road flares... it's up to you. [/b]

[h3]Repair your Patrol Cars[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/3305ca18f3aa7267b2bf3c12af430e6024c6cd49.jpg[/img]
You had an accident? In the past, your patrol car was either slightly or even completely wrecked in the aftermath. That sucks! :(

But now, you can repair them in the middle of the shift and don't need to wait for the next one. You can either repair them quickly with the press of a button when standing in front of the garage, or do it inside. 

[b]Bring your patrol cars back to life![/b]

[h2]Car Balancing[/h2]

Yes, we know. In the past, driving a car hasn't been the most pleasant experience. While we did ship some improvements to their handling in the past, we now completely overhauled all the patrol vehicles and improved controls across the board. [b]They definitely don't feel like you're on ice skates anymore![/b]

[h2]Introducing: The Compact Police Vehicle[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/384af8f03668aa1e28ce5fdffb63acdf27b774a8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Now available: The Stacking Charges Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/bbc72dc4c79b5ebffbf81b90ad833ff27fc8157b.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
Today we’re happy to finally release [b]The Stacking Charges Update[/b], now available to all players of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/][b]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/b][/url]! 

[h2]Introducing: Stack and hand out multiple charges [/h2]

This feature was one of the most frequently requested, constantly being on top of the most upvoted ones on our official Trello Roadmap. As it provides another layer of realism – and quality of life, that’s for sure – it was an absolute no-brainer to start working on it.

To ensure that this feature actually works, the team had to overhaul the UI when interacting with an NPC. When selecting ‘Issue Violations’, a new window called ‘Select Violations’ is shown on the right side of the screen. Selected violations will be put into this window, providing a constant overview of the applied charges, in addition to them being highlighted in the general interaction wheel. This way, you can give multiple or all violations at the same time – and are also able to arrest NPCs for multiple liabilities. Good to know: You will of course receive SP (or lose CP!) for every handed-out violation. 

So, if they were spraying graffiti, start fleeing, stole their ID card, and possess a ton of drugs… well, time to overwhelm them with charges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/57a986fe1f42e89edc3052930f90189c049ab8c1.png[/img]

[h2]What else is in the update?[/h2]

In addition to this feature, we have fixed a number of bugs and resolved a lot of crashes, improving the overall stability of the game. Always nice to see, heh? 

Since the release of 8.0.0, a lot of you reported that too few or too many callouts were coming in. Our team investigated the issue intensively and discovered what was causing it, which ultimately required a rebalancing of the underlying system that causes callouts to be triggered. If you discover anything else in this regard, please send us a report and we’ll take a look :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/7e220a1292d00bf71e5e0fa0f047c77bd88b4da8.png[/img]

[h2]So, what’s coming next?[/h2]

Just two weeks ago, we revealed our plans for the future of PS:PO – sharing a first look at the very next update, and the features we have greenlit and will be part of future updates. 

If you want to dive into details, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/997010/announcements/detail/6521815776484645649][b]please check out the blog post for more information[/b][/url], it’s worth it! 

https://steamcommunity.com/games/997010/announcements/detail/6521815776484645649

notes.title: The future of PS:PO
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/500820306ffc6865147c58aa8ac2f0f67f9518da.jpg[/img]

[b]Fellow officers,[/b]

we hope you had a good start into spring and are already looking forward to Easter! We looked around, filled our baskets, and found some amazing surprises along the way... including a first look at what's ahead of us when it comes to new content for Police Simulator: Patrol Officers!

Earlier this year, we went through all your wishes, the most upvoted Trello cards, thousands of comments, and evaluated their scope and possibility. That took quite a while (sorry for keeping you waiting!) but we have now greenlit a lot of things that are planned for the next updates in 2023 and beyond.

[h2]Changes in updates 9.0.0 and 10.0.0[/h2]

First things first: Last year, we already announced the content that comes with the updates 9.0.0 and 10.0.0. Considering the updates that will come afterwards we decided that some changes needed to be made.

Being able to tackle a suspect will unfortunately not come with the next update 9.0.0, currently scheduled to release later this month. We believe that it makes much more sense to include it in a future update together with some additional, very fitting features. No worries, tackling suspect will still come – but at a later date :)

Update 10.0.0 will change completely: We're happy to announce that it is now themed around our patrol cars which truly deserve an overhaul and additional care. With the update, you will have the ability to change your car via a garage that you can find directly in-game. Change your selection of cars in front of the precinct according to your personal preference. You are also able to repair your cars via the garage! You will also be able to manage which trunk tools you want to take on patrol via the garage so you are perfectly prepared for your next callout.

Another change you can look forward to relates to the entire physics system and car handling and physics of our PVs: We're introducing an entirely new physics engine, switching to Chaos Physics. We'll share more details about the content of 10.0.0 the closer we get to it and we can't wait for it!

[h2]What comes next?[/h2]

The future looks bright: Internally, we have laid out a plan for the entirety of 2023 and even the beginning of 2024. [url=https://trello.com/b/YeMg9IAp/police-simulator-patrol-officers-early-access-roadmap/][b]On our Trello[/b][/url], we shifted a bunch of cards (including a lot of highly upvoted ones) into the 'Community Feedback: Officially Greenlit' column, meaning that we plan to include them in future updates. Please be aware that this column is not 100% final, some things [i]miiiiiiight[/i] be subject to change, but we have them all in mind and are really looking forward to them!

However, we also removed some of the older stuff in the column as it has been severly outdated. That might sound disappointing but we believe that we included much more frequently requested features that provide more value.

The features and improvements you see in the column are not sorted by updates yet – that's why only updates 9.0.0 and 10.0.0 are currently present. We will shift them into the update packages (11.0.0, 12.0.0, 13.0.0...) the closer we get to one. Keep an eye on Trello and do not forget to vote for your favorite remaining features, there's a chance they will be considered in the future as well!

We can't wait for all your feedback and wish you a lot of fun going through the greenlit features and discover what we have planned for the future of PS:PO.

[h2]Self-Defense[/h2]

De-escalation, self-defense, and usage of a service pistol: We are actively and intensively researching the possibilities of including such scenarios in the game. It is important to us not to change the nature of the game but be as close as possible to reality. We take the matter very seriously, which is why the evaluation may take a while. Next to our research, we are consulting a bunch of former and active police officers from the United States and talk to those who have been part of the police in bigger cities. Please bear with us while we are working on the scope of these features, we do have them in mind, but we would like to give it a purpose, make it meaningful, keep it realistic and be aware of the consequences.

Just to provide an insight into another hurdle we are trying to work out: Currently, PS:PO is rated T (= age 13 and up) and their equivalent in most regions, primarily because a scenario where you must use the gun is not present at the moment. This causes a huge issue: If we introduce gun usage, there IS a risk that the age rating will be raised, causing a lot of problems as people who have already bought the game might have expected it to stay at this rating – and not for it to be completely different. We have to keep in mind the expectations of all our players and really want to do things right. In the meantime, we are talking to all agencies and partners involved to check if there's a solution, but it will take a while.

Thank you all for your patience, we know stuff hasn't been perfect in the last few months. The teams at both Aesir and astragon love PS:PO so much and we work hard to polish and advance it further. Thank you for your support, your feedback, your understanding, your engagement, your passion. We do not take it for granted.

[b]Your Police Simulator Team [/b]

notes.title: Hotfix Update 8.3.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/22921215857ada5010535ebdcd5e350abf423f5d.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
We hope you had an amazing weekend! Today, we're releasing [b]Update 8.3.0[/b] which is fully focused on resolving some pressing issues that came up over the last few weeks and months.

[b]First things first:[/b] The biggest problem that required a lot of internal resources were the invisible cars that caused frequent and truly frustrating car crashes. Fixing this bug was our main priority with this update and it turned out to be far more complicated than we initially anticipated. Our team investigated the issue extensively and... yikes, was it difficult.

[b]Here's what we found out:[/b] When a car is despawned it remains in its last location until it is required elsewhere. When it is eventually required, the traffic simulation moves the car to its new location and turns the visualization and collision back on. The issue was that the collision of the car is not transported to the new location until some frames after it moved to the new location which causes it to exist in the old location for the same period. If the player is inside the collision zone of the car in that moment he is thrown off the map, gets a "car totaled" game over or gets stuck in the ground which leads the game to eventually crash. In that brief period you can also run into the invisible car while driving. This very short time window and the collision not being visible in even our debugging tools was why it was so hard for us to consistently reproduce the issue and why it took us so long to figure it out.

We hope that the related issues are now fixed – should you still encounter them, please report the bug with a video so that the team can investigate them further.

[b]FYI:[/b] In some threads we mentioned that we are also working on update 8.4.0 before pushing out 9.0.0. We now decided to migrate 8.4.0 into 9.0.0 instead as we believe to have discovered the reason for the issue of seemingly no callouts coming in. However, we want to take a little bit more time with resolving it.

Have a look at the full changelog here:

[*] Fixed an issue where a player could collide with something Invisible during the gameplay when driving with a patrol car 
[*] Fixed an issue in multiplayer where players lost the ability to place & remove a wanted NPC in patrol car
[*] Fixed issues related to road flare placement and the outlines of road flare placement not being accurate
[*] Fixed an issue in multiplayer where the client would not see the intuition message for the host toggling callouts on & off
[/list]

Christmas and New Year's Eve are upon us – and we have a new update ready for you... today!

Welcome to Update 8.0.0, now available to all players of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/url][/b]!

[h2]Introducing: Update 8.0.0[/h2]

Oh, you're surprised it's out already? Understandable. Initially, we planned to release the update in January. But as development has progressed quite smoothly, we are able to push it out ahead of schedule. Isn't that nice?

[h2]What's inside?[/h2]

Since leaving Early Access, we have started to collect all of your amazing feedback and included it into our internal development roadmap. Thank you all, it helps a lot! 💙

notes.title: Developer Q&A with Aesir Interactive
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/22f8061a1015a322fafb03c15594eaa42a29f1c3.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow Officers,[/h3][/i]

[b]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/b] has officially been out for just a week now! 🥳 It’s been a whirlwind of a week and we’ve definitely been busy looking at all your great feedback.

Considering that our PS:PO community has grown a lot within the last few weeks, we thought it’d be a good time to answer some frequently asked questions for players old and new.

For this, we’ve prepared a little Q&A with the lovely developer team at Aesir Interactive, so that you can not only get a look behind the scenes but also get to know the team behind the game a little better. 🤍

[h2]Developer Q&A[/h2]

[b]How has Early Access impacted the development of PS:PO?[/b]

Early Access really changed the development, especially in regard to all the features we implemented. We really listened to you and took all your feedback into consideration - and even changed our development priorities based on that. And that will continue in the future! 


[b]What future content are you most excited to develop (which is on the [url=http://roadmap.patrol-officers.com/]Trello[/url])? [/b]

For us it is definitely being able to stack charges - we can't wait for that! Finally, we'll charge the criminals accordingly... 


[b]How do you identify what to add to the game next? What is the process? [/b]

It starts with a suggestion from the community, ourselves or from astragon. Then we check how we can pull it off and how it would meet realism the most. After that we check how long it would take us to implement it and if we all agree on the feature, we search for the best possible timing and plan it into our development roadmap. 


[b]What is your favorite district in the game? [/b]

Melting Pot! We really like the Melting Pot district because it is the one with the most diversity in the buildings and in the people.    


[b]How have IRL police officers helped you with your development of the game?[/b]

We're working together with a little team of four police officers from the United States which we can get always contact to receive their advice. We ask them everytime for every feature or change we do or plan to do in the game. 


[b]What’s your favorite feature in the game? [/b]

Definitely the co-op function, everything is more fun with a friend 🙂 


[b]Will there be more callouts in the future? [/b]

Currently our priorities are set to focus on bringing more depth to the game. 


[b]Are you planning on extending multiplayer? [/b]

Unfortunately, we won't be able to extend the Multiplayer due to technical constraints. 


[b]Will crossplay be supported at some point? [/b]

Unfortunately, no, crossplay is a huge technical task and with the current feature plan we are not able to do it. 


[b]Are there plans to add more playable characters? [/b]

Currently that isn't planned. 


[b]Can you give us a sneak peek of what we can expect in Update 8.0.0?[/b]

We think [url=http://roadmap.patrol-officers.com/]Trello[/url] gives you a good overview of what to expect. Make sure to check it out regularly and vote for your features! 


Do you have more questions concerning PS:PO? Leave them in the comments down below because there’s going to be a live Q&A with Aesir Interactive [i]very[/i] soon! 👀
More details to follow. 

Thank you to everyone playing the game and of course to the developers at Aesir Interactive! This game is a group effort of all of us combined and we’re very proud of what it's become and where it’s still going in the future!

notes.title: End of Early Access - Official Release OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/2e85dc791e9a75d358bb4bf76cac990ec4be0b34.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
Today is the day! We’ve graduated from being an Early Access game and are ready to conquer the gaming world as a fully released game. Since embarking on this journey in June 2021, we’ve grown so much: We’ve added  
[list]
[*] 7 content updates (more to come!),  
[*] 20 achievements,  
[*] 49 violations,  
[*] 10 tools,  
[*] 13 languages,  
[*] 2289 localization lines  
[*] and so much more!  
[/list]
And we also got to welcome 7311 of you on our discord! Thanks for sticking with us! We couldn’t have done this without you! 🤍 

You can also check out our End of Early Access Trailer with a special message from the developers at Aesir Interactive. 

[previewyoutube=VpQ4w3mxVOM;full][/previewyoutube]

But enough of all these sentimentalities… We’d like to welcome you to Update 7.3.0, the official release update of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/url][/b]!

[h2][b]Introducing: Update 7.3.0 [/b][/h2]

Yeah, this is indeed 7.3.0 - we initially had a 7.2.0 but then we put together another update and practically merged it with the one before, thus evolving into 7.3.0. But let’s have a look at what’s new in 7.3.0! 

[b]This officer is currently not available[/b] 

We are aware that sometimes incoming callouts can be quite annoying, especially when you’re already in the middle of dealing with something else. That’s why you can now disable incoming callouts! 

[b]There’s room for more [/b]

Got a lot of criminals on your hand? No worries, everyone will get escorted back to the precinct. Multiple arrestees can now get cozy inside the police backup vehicle. 

[b]You shall not pass [/b]

Traffic cones and road barriers are just not enough. To help with traffic management, your police car can now act as a road blocker.  

[b]Urban Terrain Vehicle DLC [/b]

Also now available: The Urban Terrain Vehicle! The brand-new patrol car is free for all Early Access players (it’s a thank you gift 🤍). It is also available for purchase at a price of 2.99 Euro/2.49 GBP/2.99 USD. 

[b]BTW, Modders! [/b]The UTV is now supported within the modding tools. Please check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2778896763]the guide [/url]for the override values - and download the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2782471905]updated modkit[/url] which includes the new files.

[b]Bug fixes… lots of them![/b] 👾 

Check out the detailed list below, but let me tell you, lots of things have been fixed and improved!  

[b]More to come… [/b]

A lot of you have probably already seen our post-release roadmap until Q2 2023, but here’s a little reminder what you can expect from updates 8.0.0, 9.0.0 and 10.0.0! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/090807ecf41a495e68a4c4a8503dadd5e27c9298.png[/img]

[b]Also, just as a reminder:[/b]

We still recommend creating a completely [b]new save game [/b]now that we are leaving Early Access. Loading a save game that you have created during Early Access might cause unexpected behavior in the newer versions.

If you start a new journey instead of using an old save game, you will have the best experience when it comes to updated game balancing and a better learning curve while also avoiding any outdated balancing issues that might cause the game to misbehave.

Thank you so much for your support and now it is once again time to take up the badge! The city of Brighton needs you!


[b]Your Police Simulator Team [/b]


[h3][b]Here are the official patch notes for Update 7.3.0 [/b][/h3]

[b]New Features  [/b]
[list]
[*] The police backup vehicle can now fit multiple arrestees inside  
[*] Being busy/not available for incoming callouts  
[*] Make a police car act as a road blocker  
[/list]

[b]Controls  [/b]
[list]
[*] Added steering sensitivity for gamepad  
[*] Adjusted "Switch Seats" button to be a different keybind

[/list]

[*] Added player accident interactions

[*] Set new start date for the gameplay (07.11.2022)   
[*] Adjustment to giving orders to NPCs

[*] Added minimal damage threshold for player caused accidents

[*] Emergency vehicles will now not react to cones and barriers to get to the destination regardless  
[/list]

[b]NPC / NPV Behavior  [/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted road blockers in order for NPVs to react to them accordingly  
[*] Changing the way EMS acts when being stuck in traffic  
[*] Adjusted the distance the NPVs should stop behind a cone or road barrier  
[*] Adjustments to NPVs Switching lanes

notes.title: Our Post-Release Roadmap until Q2 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/959351b9a3bac04c70843f6663f0ac04cfc5c936.jpg[/img]


[b]Fellow officers,[/b]

with the official launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers [/url] only days away, it’s finally time to share more details about our post-release roadmap until Q2 2023 with you!  

Since embarking on this journey with the launch of Early Access on Steam in June 2021, we’ve tried to involve you, the player community, as much as we can. We regularly updated [url=https://trello.com/b/YeMg9IAp/police-simulator-patrol-officers-early-access-roadmap]our official Trello board[/url] with all details surrounding the latest developments in Police Simulator: Patrol Officers, added your feedback and suggestions and even got to implement a lot of the features you requested!  

But we are aware that some features on our Trello board have yet to make it into the game. Which is why today, we are happy to give you a better preview of the free updates that you can expect by mid-2023, including some first timings. 

[b]It’s time to get excited for Update 8.0.0, 9.0.0 [i]AND[/i] 10.0.0! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/090807ecf41a495e68a4c4a8503dadd5e27c9298.png[/img]

[b]Update 8.0.0 (Q1 2023)[/b] 

Are you tired of people always asking you for directions? No worries, update 8.0.0 introduces more improvements for the “Asking for directions” feature. Also, emergency vehicles will now come from the opposite lane to avoid getting stuck in traffic.  

Did you accidentally call for an ambulance or tow truck? You can now cancel the call! Your phone bill will hopefully shrink that way... it’s getting way too expensive. (Wait, aren’t we using walkie-talkies?) 


[b]Update 9.0.0 (Q1 / Q2 2023)[/b]

Got a really bad criminal on your hands? Stacking charges is finally a thing in update 9.0.0. These criminals will finally foot the whole bill, that’s what I can promise! Oh, and you can stop a fleeing person by tackling them. No need to waste the limited stun gun ammo anymore... and you’ll get a nice workout, too. The gym can wait from now on. 


[b]Update 10.0.0 (Q2 2023)[/b]

Do you enjoy going on patrol with a partner? To make it easier to interact in a multiplayer game, predefined commands will be added in update 10.0.0. Also, adjustments to balancing values to tailor your game experience can be made. In addition, the minimap will also be visible while on foot patrol outside of a vehicle. 

 
We hope this teaser will get you excited for what’s still to come! We will provide even more information the closer we get to each update, including all kinds of bug fixes and general improvements.  

We’re looking forward to working alongside you even after release to further improve and expand the game. Your feedback and involvement is what makes this game so special! 

 
Thank you so much and get ready to take up the badge on November 10!

notes.title: Road to Release: News about Save Games and Betas
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/104abc2699390a8773d2e420a8e9e44f6586d095.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello Officers,[/b]

We’re getting closer and closer to leaving Early Access on November 10 and launching a new chapter for [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/url][/b]. Some of you have been with us since the very beginning and we can not state enough how incredibly thankful we are for your support – in the past, in the present, and for everything that is yet to come.

While this is all quite exciting, we are aware that we owe you answers to some of your questions. Today we want to focus on future save game behavior and the future of our open beta program.

[h2]Will my save game be erased?[/h2]

Short answer: No!

Long answer: No, but we still recommend creating a completely new save game once we leave Early Access. Loading a save game that you have created during Early Access might cause unexpected behavior in the newer versions.

If you start a new journey instead of using an old save game, you will have the best experience when it comes to updated game balancing and a better learning curve while also avoiding any outdated balancing issues that might cause the game to misbehave.

However, if you wish, you can continue playing with your currently existing save game. We won’t take it away.

[h2]What will happen to the beta program?[/h2]

As you know, right now, we are releasing every bigger update into open beta prior to its full release – and this has been very helpful during our time in Early Access.

However, once we leave Early Access, we sadly have to say goodbye to our beta program. This is due to a more complicated and sophisticated development approach going forward – but in return, we greatly increased our own internal resources in both the development and quality assurance part!

No worries, we will continue working alongside you to further improve and expand the game. Nothing has changed about that! We are grateful for all the feedback you provide and without everything you did, the game would not have been as successful as it is right now.

[h2]How will the release work?[/h2]

Well, to be honest, it is more a formal act than an entire revolution. Once we leave Early Access on November 10, we will release the “Day One Patch” with version number 7.2.0 – and it will contain much-requested improvements like being able to turn off incoming callouts, arrest transport picking up more people and using your patrol car as a road blocker. Of course, the update will also contain a huge amount of fixes for both bugs and crashes. [i]Quite a nice care package![/i]

In addition, we will carry out a price increase when we leave Early Access. The game will then cost 29.99 Euro / 24.99 GBP / 29.99 USD on PC. This seems obvious, but just to make it clear: If you have bought the game already, you will of course keep it. The new price is only relevant to players who decide to buy the game after November 10.

Everyone who bought the game during Early Access will also receive a free DLC containing a fourth patrol car, the Urban Terrain Vehicle. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/3363646161022946085]You can find more details about it here.[/url] The DLC will become purchasable to anyone who buys the game after Early Access.

And with all that… the shiny blue Early Access badge will vanish from our store page. We’re a grown-up video game then. But as with all of us, we will continue to grow and expand – and we can’t wait to do that alongside all of you.

Thank you so much and stay safe and healthy,

[b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: Now available: Update 7.1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/a07c168454ede6dd3fbf847f593e49ae1c829a65.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
We've fixed bugs! We've improved driving! We've added new QOL features! We've improved performance! Oh, and more! Why am I shouting!

Welcome to Update 7.1.0, now available to all players of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/url][/b]!

[h2]Introducing: Update 7.1.0[/h2]

After a few weeks of beta testing, we've polished the latest update and are now happy to share the latest version with you. Today's update 7.1.0 is everything that was included in the beta update 7.0.0... and more!

Let's dive right into everything that is inside! 👏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/09e2d06f3a1f10d86c3e446233501c64e68b962d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Car control improvements![/h2]

We are very much aware that driving a patrol car has not been the most pleasant experience in the past. It felt like you're trying to dance on ice. That's why we're tackling this very issue and issue a bunch of improvements to make it a lot more enjoyable.

We've rebalanced all patrol cars to make their controls more natural so please give us your feedback on that. In addition, we've added new settings related to vehicle steering sensitivity and controller dead zone adjustments. Last but not least: You can now switch seats from inside the car!

[h2]Manage the accidents you caused[/h2]

Some of you are truly ruthless! Causing accidents left and right, bringing other NPCs in difficult situations, making them lose everything they own... but hey, it can be fun as well at times.

Now, you can manage these very accidents! Document the accident, talk to the NPC, and ensure everyone gets all the information necessary. 

Side note: The speed limit of the street will now be displayed on the screen! Not just good for your own driving behavior but also for radar gun usage...

[h2]A little bit of balancing[/h2]

If I say the following three things, will you finally be happy?!

Accidents will now happen less.
You will get fewer NPCs asking for directions.
Crimes are now happening farther away so that wallet thefts and so on won't happen right in front of your eyes.

Yes. Admit it. This feels good.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/79a9769a551b9da750e0d417532fc3e8abaac9ae.jpg[/img]

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]

We've optimized the game in several areas to further improve performance by reducing memory usage, deleting unused assets and adjusting the number of parked NPVs (which, as a side effect, should bring other improvements with it).

[h2]Hungarian Language[/h2]

This is only possible thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/John_Barth]John Bart[/url] who spent his last few months working on the mod, translating the ENTIRE game to Hungarian. We can not even slightly imagine how much work that must have been so please thank him for his tremendous effort!

If you want to switch to Hungarian, you only have to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2856567731]head over to the Steam Workshop and subscribe to the mod[/url]! We'll make sure, together with him, that this localization option will get updated over time as well!

Thank you John Bart for all your efforts, it has been awesome working alongside you <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/d021c2b8295912566d30f6819d42111a002677fc.jpg[/img]

[h2]What our next steps look like[/h2]

This update has probably been the very last one before we leave Early Access on November 10th. However, we are already working on the next one which will have the version number 7.2.0 and release on that exact date - becoming our day-one-patch, so to say.

With the next update, we'll once again focus on the three pillars which already shaped today's update: Bug fixes, QOL features, and performance improvements.

Just to give you an outlook on what will await you on November 10th:

[list]
[*] You will get an option to become unavailable to the dispatchers.
[*] You can use your patrol car as a road blocker.
[*] Arrest transport can now pick up more people.
[*] Much-needed improvements to emergency vehicle behavior.
[*] You will be able to place cones between lanes or intermediate behavior.
[*] ... and more.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/540141135dfdc652a5855860e8b205269be8acb1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Here are the official patch notes for Update 7.1.0[/h2]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] You are now able to manage player-caused accidents
[*] Hungarian language is now supported as a mod pack (more details above!)
[/list]
[b]Car Control[/b]
[list]
[*] Added vehicle steering sensitivity and controller dead zone adjustments to settings under controls
[*] You can now switch seats from inside the car
[*] Rebalanced all the police cars to make the driving more enjoyable
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Speed limit of the street is now being displayed on the screen
[*] Improved Radar gun behavior when standing in a park
[*] Updated the start date of the game when creating a new save
[*] Cones and barriers now have light strips to make them more visible during night shifts
[*] Improved the “move/wait” traffic gesture to handle stuck cars
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the minimum distance from the player where the NPC can commit crimes. Stuff like wallet thefts should now not happen right in front of your eyes.
[*] Increased the cooldown for asking for direction feature: NPCs should not spam you with directions requests anymore
[*] Decreased the accident callouts frequency
[*] Rebalanced the fallback trigger for Ambulance and Arrest transport officers
[/list]
[b]Performance Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the memory used by some game textures

[*] Deleted more non-used animations with no references

[b]Animations[/b]

[b]Tutorials[/b]

notes.title: We're leaving Early Access on November 10th - and here's all you need to know!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/dbe02ca1eb9d151262e049e611da96f054f75852.jpg[/img]

[h3][i]Fellow officers,[/i][/h3]

yes, it's happening – as announced last time, after more than a year, we're actually leaving Early Access. What a ride it has been... Just take a look at all the updates we've released thus far! Without your feedback and incredible engagement, we would never have been able to follow our vision of creating the best possible Police Simulator out there.

I'd go as far as saying: [b][i]You made it all possible.[/i][/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/3400798320981468872]In the latest blog post[/url], we only mentioned that we *are* leaving Early Access. Well, now we have a date for you as well: [b]November 10th, 2022[/b].

[i](Some of you spotted the leaks in the last few weeks, but psht, that never happened, all fake of course.)[/i]

[h2]I missed it, why are you leaving Early Access?[/h2]

We mentioned it in the initial announcement but no worries, I think it's important to get into detail: 

We've been developing the game for some time now with frequent updates that have brought both content we planned and features the community wanted into the game. And there has been a lot. We are now at a development stage, where we are feeling confident to give players a well-rounded full gameplay experience not only on PC but (yes, on November 10th as well!) [b]also on consoles[/b]. Just to clarify: Despite that, we are very much aware of lots of quirks we still need to tackle.

[h2]What comes after Early Access?[/h2]

You probably have some questions regarding a revised roadmap and similar things. Unfortunately, we won't be able to give you an update at this very moment as we're still working on the details and everything is just not... ready. However, some of the stuff you have wished for is still definitely coming! This includes *banger features* like:
[list]
[*] A brand-new powerful vehicle: The Urban Terrain Vehicle which will be FREE to all players joining us in Early Access! From release the additional patrol vehicle will be available as DLC at a price of 2.99 Euro/2.49 GBP/2.99 USD. It's a [i]thank you[/i] gift <3
[*] An additional alternative to stop fleeing suspects: By aiming or using a stun gun or by aiming the police gun, fleeing suspects can be made to stop. With one of the free updates, stopping by physical force will also be possible.
[*] Hand out multiple tickets: When Brighton residents commit offenses, virtual enforcement officers can ask them to pay a fine or warn them. A free update will bring the possibility to charge all amounts cumulatively into the game.
[*] Even more co-op fun: When patrol officers go on patrol together in co-op mode, the communication between them must work perfectly. A free update will implement helpful command shortcuts into the game with which they can communicate even better and in a more targeted manner. Only through perfect teamwork will they be able to keep law and order in Brighton.
[/list]
[i]Psht... this is what your new car looks like...[/i]👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/dbe4881e4e86d5edfbf90c1b7fb3773900ea140e.jpg[/img]

[h2]What else is there to say?[/h2]

So, so, so, so, so much. But it's hard to put it all into words.

We'll be at gamescom starting... [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/3400799589582675654]tomorrow[/url]! And stay there for the rest of the week. We can't wait to see you, for the very first time, in person. Come to booth B-040 in Hall 7 and say hi, we're there for a chat!

No worries, we plan to host [url=https://youtu.be/Mi4i0gQBwgY]a digital AMA[/url] as well. More details soon.

Yours dearly,
[b]The entire Police Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: We're leaving Early Access – but are far from done yet
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/3d1d9629bf5ba3a56f2890d94502f9951899357a.png[/img]

[h3][i]Fellow officers,[/i][/h3]

let me tell you one thing: The last 13 1/2 months have been [b]incredible[/b]. It's been an extraordinary pleasure to see so many of you having fun, interacting with the community, enjoying the duties of Brighton, and providing us with extremely valuable feedback. Just take a look at our last updates which have been heavily inspired by your wishes and we’re so excited to continue on this path alongside you.

Speaking of it: Yes, you read the headline correctly. We are indeed leaving Steam Early Access soon.

[h2]Why are you leaving Early Access?[/h2]

There are several reasons which all cumulated to our decision.

We initially planned to stay in Early Access for 'up to a year' – well, we're way past that point but have never actually updated the FAQ :D Now we're a bit late, but hey!

Since our release in Early Access in July 2021 we think with 6 major content updates including free-roam and multiplayer mode, more complex tasks, new vehicles and districts the game has advanced and progressed in a way where we believe finally leaving Early Access is justified.

Plus: The game will release on consoles at the same time as well (that means: PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S). You won't believe how many requests we received for that, crazy to see that much hype! 💙

[h2]Is that it now? :([/h2]

No, not at all! Just to make it completely clear: This is not the end, we're far from done! Actually, we have soooo much more in store and can not wait to share all the details with you. Update 7, Update 8... and much much more are already in the works and AHHHHH I WISH I COULD JUST LEAK THEM ALL!

You could say… After Early Access, we’re continuing with the Early Access Definitive Hyper Premium Extended Edition™©℗®. With a few changes but more news about that soon.

BTW: We are still in the process of finding a proper date but we will most likely (not 100% safe!) have some information for you about both the release and new content coming in the future at gamescom. Stay tuned on that! :)

[i]Oh, and not to forget: We are aware of a few issues which sneaked in with Update 6, especially when it comes to crashes. Our team is working on them and we plan to release a hotfix next week.[/i]

[h2]What will change once you leave Early Access?[/h2]

The most important thing: We'll carry out a very first (and so far only!) price increase when we leave Early Access. The game will then cost 29.99 Euro / 24.99 GBP / 29.99 USD.

Of course, if you have already purchased the game prior to that date, you will not have to pay anything additionally to cover the gap. This seems obvious but I just want to make it clear: If you already own the game, nothing will change for you. You already own it, possess it, love it. Nothing will be taken away from you.

Should something else change, we will inform you about that in time.

[h2]A gift to our Early Access players[/h2]

We can not thank you enough for your incredible support over the last few years. Seriously, even I feel personally flattered :')

On console, players who pre-order the game will receive a bonus in form of a powerful SUV – we call it the [i]Urban Terrain Vehicle[/i]. On PC, we decided to gift this patrol car to all our existing Early Access players (= everyone who owns the game until we leave Early Access). That's just fair, you know :)

However, we don't want to make any kind of bonus content exclusive to one version or to a specific timeframe. This is why we will also offer this little bonus as a separate purchase (2.99 Euro / 2.49 GBP / 2.99 USD) to those who join us a little later!

We plan to work on additional DLC in the future which we want to offer as a way to further support the development – we're sizing up a [b]lot[/b] of things and are thankful for every help we get, especially when it comes to feedback. Please continue doing that!

[h2]Thank you all for the support[/h2]

At no point prior to release would we have expected such success and at times it felt really overwhelming. We're incredibly thankful for every single comment – be it both positive or negative – as they help us to improve and expand the game further and further.

Thank you so, so, so much for the incredible support and we can not wait for the months to come!

Yours dearly,
[b]The entire Police Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: OUT NOW: The Traffic Management Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/4fc27eb4a8a048923d8452cd01498d7f7bd51c46.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
Taking control over something is always the best way to approach things. And now, you can be the master of traffic - with your cones, barriers, gestures and much more. Wait, did I just spoiler things? I hope not! Welcome to [b]The Traffic Management Update[/b]!

Now available to all players of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/url][/b]!

[previewyoutube=KZjKi2HsPas;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Introducing: The Traffic Management Update[/h2]

Safety first. We always pledged that. And that's why the Brighton Police Department invested heavily into new tools and guidelines to help all officers in their craft.

Check out the trunk of your patrol car - [b]new goodies await you[/b]! Use your cones and barriers to block off individual lanes, entire streets, secure accident sites, or annoy other drivers! [i]The latter one is a joke, please don't do that. Some of you did that in the beta and we received some complaints...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/5cbf82fd76d72f9a00c457afdbf8eaf33ff39b68.jpg[/img]

[h2]Use your commands![/h2]

Why do you have hands? Yes, to carry things from A to B. But more important: You can use them to [b]perform gestures & issue commands[/b]!

With The Traffic Management Update, you receive a variety of options just for that! 

You can now order...
[list]
[*] NPCs to stop and wait
[*] NPCs to walk to a different location and wait there
[*] NPCs to not use the sidewalk at all
[*] NPCs to turn around and use a different route
[*] NPVs to wait
[*] NPVs to turn around and use a different route
[*] NPVs to reverse drive
[/list]We highly recommend using a combination of tools and manual commands to redirect traffic in a way that suits your present needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/98036cc2a8ae3f69d36f44341f6b5855cf6ed6dd.jpg[/img] 

[h2]Mod your ELS![/h2]

Oh lord, never ever could we have anticipated [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/997010/workshop/]the huge amount of mods you would create[/url]! It was clear to us that you really want to receive even more options to modify, personalize and optimize the game.

That's why we couldn't wait to introduce [b]ELS Modding[/b] which enables you to adjust both sirens and blipping, customize all lights on all patrol cars, change the frequency, switch up the brightness and variate the colors.

Of course, we've both updated the official mod kit and written a guide to help you with your creations! Check it out here:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2808924041

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/b5441d972875e4cf8c882d03d52a49794c9f91d1.jpg[/img]

[h2]A smarter AI[/h2]

While we give you a bunch of new options to direct traffic yourself, it was crucial to optimize the AI at the same time. We're shipping a bunch of [b]AI improvements[/b] that include a smart reaction to sirens, a better approach to intersections, an advanced lane switching behavior... and more. If you want to take a closer look at the changes, we've created an article with a few example videos:

https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/997010/announcements/detail/3337742851856313742
[h2]Bug fixes, performance improvements & other new features[/h2]

As with the last updates, the team put a tremendous focus on fixing a bunch of longstanding bugs. A huge 'thank you' to everyone that helped us in the last few weeks of beta! You can take a closer look at them in the patch notes further down below.

We also resolved a bunch of crashes - and improved performance plus framerates across the board. In addition, you can now adjust the spawn density of NPCs and NPVs while fleeing has become an official arrest reason!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/e9287dfb4dfa4cb30eacf60304c0210e4d3a5e38.jpg[/img]

[h2]Time to go on patrol again![/h2]

If you haven't seen it already, we released a new episode of #ONPATROL a few weeks ago! If you want to learn more about the development of this update and receive some exclusive behind-the-scenes insights, we can only recommend taking a look:

[previewyoutube=kdlCueSa_gI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Save 30%![/h2]

For a very limited time, you can save 30% when purchasing PS:PO on our official website! [url=https://www.astragon.com/deals][b]Click here[/b][/url] to learn more as this is by far our deepest discount yet 👀

[h2]Here are the official patch notes for The Traffic Management Update[/h2]

Enough said - let's get to the patch notes!

[b]Traffic Management[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Traffic Cones: Players can now place traffic cones around the accidents and on the road in general, to make traffic around them more manageable
[*] Added Road Barriers: Players can now place road barriers on roads and around accident sites, to make the NPVs take a different route
[*] Added Hand Gestures: Players are able to order NPVs to stop driving, continue driving, drive in reverse and do a u-turn, which makes the player to be in control of the vehicle drivers around him
[*] Giving orders to NPCs: The player now has the ability to make an NPC wait, or evacuate the area they are currently in to make the player be in control of any situation around him
[/list]
[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new modding system for ELS: Players now can change their police vehicle emergency lights and sounds for the emergency siren (can't wait to see what you'll create!)
[/list]
[b]AI & NPC Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the way NPCs and NPVs react to the police car with lights, emergency siren and lights & siren together
[*] Improved traffic behavior at intersections
[*] Added AI improvements which make the AI more human-like: NPCs react to the police cars sirens and actions around them, if there are gunshots or taser being deployed (instead of chilling like nothing has happened at all and that is just a regular occurence in their neighborhood, just like an old lady throwing flower pots at you just because you've been a biiiit louder when gaming, smh)
[*] Changed the stopping distance between NPVs in traffic and on accident sites
[*] Added more functionality to NPCs feet making their walking more realistic
[*][i] Changed during beta: [/i]Improved NPV lane switching logic: NPVs will not block traffic when they want to switch lanes
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the names of NPCs in Encounter reports to make it clearer what actions and NPCs caused loss or gain of the CP/SP (now you know who to blame)
[*] Improved the handbook, added categories to make it easier to search through the handbook entries
[*] Added warning pop-up messages after player changes the spawn density/range settings
[*] Adjusted in-game credits (it's me!!)
[*][i] Changed during beta: [/i]Added more intuition feedback to assist players in placing road blockers (thanks for the suggestion, Slayer!)
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now arrest someone for fleeing
[/list]
[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvement of overall in-game performance
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjustment of NPC spawning range and density in multiplayer
[*][i] Changed during beta: [/i]Increased the speed requirement between NPV and player car to 35 mph to register as an accident
[*][i] Changed during beta: [/i]Increased the distance between player and accident site for despawning of vehicles
[*][i] Changed during beta: [/i]Increased the distance between player and NPV for hand gestures: Now players can use hand gestures from a longer distance
[*][i] Changed during beta: [/i]Another attempt at decreasing the frequency of wallet thefts (maybe it works out this time...)
[*][i] Changed during beta: [/i]Increased amount of cones to carry from 2 to 4
[/list]
[b]Tutorials[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Tutorial "Radar-Gun" which explains how to use the Radar Gun
[*] Added new Tutorial "Stun Gun" which explains when and how to deploy a taser
[*] Added new Tutorial "Flashlight" which explains how to turn on your flashlight
[*] Added new Tutorial "Driving with a broken Windshield" which explains when a driver should be detained for their broken windshield
[*] Added new Tutorial "Open Patrol" which explains the basics of playing an open patrol shift
[*] Added new Tutorial "High Crime Area" which explains to the player what is a high crime area in the game
[*] Added new Tutorial "Fleeing" that explains what should be done, if an NPC is fleeing
[*] Adjusted Gun tutorial text to make it clearer when it is allowed to use your gun during the shift
[/list]
[b]Happy Birthday![/b]
[list]
[*] Decorated the precincts to celebrate our one-year anniversary!
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[i]GAMEPLAY[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a player would get stuck in a fleeing dialogue
[*] Fixed issues where SP could get farmed
[*] Fixed an issue for there being no CP loss after tasing an injured NPC
[*] Fixed issue where a player could tase a driver NPC
[*] Fixed an issue where Traffic Stop parking slots would not get properly filled by the NPVs

[/list]
[i]MULTIPLAYER[/i]

notes.title: We need your help: How to report performance problems
notes.content:

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]

However, we still want to optimize the game as much as possible but without your help, this will probably not be feasible. Especially in recent weeks, we've heard from a few users with special hardware configurations – primarily those that include an AMD CPU – that they have observed an increase in performance problems. notes.title: Delaying the release of The Traffic Management Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/264ef377b345d9c733bc601a04e24caf709fad2d.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
The last few weeks have been incredibly exciting: With the start of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/3337742851867170921][b]Beta for The Traffic Management Update[/b][/url], thousands have started to discover the new set of features, possibilities, and tools included.

While the feedback has definitely been positive, it became clear that a bunch of work is still necessary. We've collected a loooot of feedback [i](that spreadsheet is definitely a colossus...)[/i] and have already started our work on improving everything around the update. We think it is better to delay the update and take more time to improve it - and [b]not[/b] push it out for the sake of pushing it out.

[b]This is why we ultimately decided against releasing the stable build on June 28 and instead delay the entire Traffic Management Update to July 12, 2022.[/b]

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/3337742851867170921]one of our last blog posts[/url], we already mentioned a planned beta hotfix in which the currently missing reverse driving feature will be included. [b]This beta hotfix will now be released on June 28.[/b]

So, in short:[list]
[*] Beta Hotfix: June 28, 2022
[*] Stable Release: July 12, 2022
[/list]Yes, this is the very first time we are actively delaying an entire update. But we strongly believe it is for the better and hope to have your understanding.

If you haven't yet checked out [i]The Traffic Management Update[/i], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/3337742851867170921][b]you can just switch over to the beta branch[/b][/url]. We will still collect feedback over the weeks to come and improve the game based on what you have to say.

With love,
[b]Your Police Simulator Team[/b]

[i]PS: The second episode of [url=https://youtu.be/kdlCueSa_gI][b]ON PATROL[/b][/url], centered around The Traffic Management Update, is out now! Make sure to tune in and learn more about how the development process works:[/i]

notes.title: The Traffic Management Update is coming on July 12 – Open Beta starts now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/5526de2298edccf11994c2d85638f3d8e7e02f13.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
just recently I watched the new Doctor Strange movie and realized: Wow, being able to redirect a car falling down from the sky after being smashed by a weird demon through a portal... that's pretty neat. While you can not perform magic in [i]our [/i]game, we will provide you with other ways to take control of traffic!

[b]Welcome to The Traffic Management Update - now available in Open Beta before the full update launches on July 12th![/b]

[h2]Introducing: The Traffic Management Update[/h2]

Safety first. We always pledged that. And that's why the Brighton Police Department invested heavily into new tools and guidelines to help all officers in their craft.

Check out the trunk of your patrol car - [b]new goodies await you[/b]! Use your cones and barriers to block off individual lanes, entire streets, secure accident sites, or annoy other drivers! [i]The latter one is a joke, please don't do that.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/5cbf82fd76d72f9a00c457afdbf8eaf33ff39b68.jpg[/img]

[h2]Use your commands![/h2]

Why do you have hands? Yes, to carry things from A to B. [i]And yes, also to hold a gamepad.[/i] But more important: You can use them to [b]perform gestures & issue commands[/b]!

With The Traffic Management Update, you receive a variety of options just for that! 

You can now order...
[list]
[*] NPCs to stop and wait
[*] NPCs to walk to a different location and wait there
[*] NPCs to not use the sidewalk at all
[*] NPCs to turn around and use a different route
[*] NPVs to wait
[*] NPVs to turn around and use a different route
[*] NPVs to reverse drive
[/list]We highly recommend using a combination of tools and manual commands to redirect traffic in a way that suits your present needs.

[b]Note: The option to order NPVs to reverse is not present in the beta yet! We currently plan to release a hotfix on June 28th which will contain this option.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/98036cc2a8ae3f69d36f44341f6b5855cf6ed6dd.jpg[/img] 

[h2]Mod your ELS![/h2]

Oh lord, never ever could we have anticipated [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/997010/workshop/]the huge amount of mods you would create[/url]! It was clear to us that you really want to receive even more options to modify, personalize and optimize the game.

That's why we couldn't wait to introduce [b]ELS Modding[/b] which enables you to adjust both sirens and blipping, customize all lights on all patrol cars, change the frequency, switch up the brightness and variate the colors.

[i]Note: Of course, you can currently only use ELS mods with the beta branch and NOT with the stable branch.[/i]

Of course, we've both updated the official mod kit and written a guide to help you with your creations! Check it out here:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2808924041

[h2]Smarter AI, Happier I[/h2]

While we give you a bunch of new options to direct traffic yourself, it was crucial to optimize the AI at the same time. We're shipping a bunch of [b]AI improvements[/b] that include a smart reaction to sirens, a better approach to intersections, an advanced lane switching behavior... and more. If you want to take a closer look at the changes, we've created an article with a few example videos:

https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/997010/announcements/detail/3337742851856313742
[h2]Bug fixes, performance improvements & other new features[/h2]

As with the last updates, the team put a tremendous focus on fixing a bunch of longstanding bugs. You can take a closer look at them in the patch notes further down below.

We also resolved a bunch of crashes - and improved performance plus framerates across the board. In addition, you can now adjust the spawn density of NPCs and NPVs while fleeing has become an official arrest reason!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/e9287dfb4dfa4cb30eacf60304c0210e4d3a5e38.jpg[/img]

[h2]How do I enter the Open Beta?[/h2]

We've made the process as easy as possible to include you, the community, early on during the development of the game. To join the Open Beta, you only need to perform the following steps:

[olist]
[*]Right-click on Police Simulator: Patrol Officers in your Steam library.
[*]Select 'Properties' in the menu.
[*]Select 'Betas' in the sidebar on the left.
[*]Select 'Beta' in the drop-down menu and confirm your decision to switch to that branch.
[*]An update should now start - you are now officially part of the Open Beta!
[/olist]
To switch back to your stable save game, just repeat these steps again - but instead of selecting 'Beta', you just select 'None'. Easy.

Everyone can test the beta extensively and provide feedback on its features, balancing, and bugs. Feel free to send us your impressions on [url=https://discord.gg/astragon]Discord[/url], in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/997010/discussions/2/]Steam Beta forums[/url] and [url=https://linktr.ee/policesimulator]on our Socials[/url].

[h2]Save game to unlock everything in the beta[/h2]

By [url=https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/175008087931879425/955540091865014415/Career_0beta.sav][b]visiting this link[/b][/url], you can download a save game for use on the beta branch (and [b]only[/b] on the beta branch!). This save game will unlock all features immediately. You also need to know that you must copy the save game into the following folder:

[i][b]C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Boston\Saved\SaveGames[/b]
You can find the folder more easily by typing %localappdata% into the Windows search.[/i]

Since the save is named [b]Career_0beta.sav[/b], you have to delete any other save game which might also be called [i]Career_0beta.sav[/i]. We recommend doing a backup of the old save game as well should you want to keep it for the future.

Of course, this is completely optional and intended to help those who want to see everything unlocked in the beta from the very start. The old method of unlocking stuff does still work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/b5441d972875e4cf8c882d03d52a49794c9f91d1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Here are the official patch notes for The Traffic Management Update[/h2]

No more talking, now it's time for the Open Beta!

[b]Traffic Management[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Traffic Cones: Players can now place traffic cones around the accidents and on the road in general, to make traffic around them more manageable
[*] Added Road Barriers: Players can now place road barriers on roads and around accident sites, to make the NPVs take a different route
[*] Added Hand Gestures: Players are able to order NPVs to stop/continue driving and do a u-turn, which makes the player to be in control of the vehicle drivers around him
[*] Giving orders to NPCs: The player now has the ability to make an NPC wait, or evacuate the area they are currently in to make the player be in control of any situation around him
[/list]
[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new modding system for ELS: Players now can change their police vehicle emergency lights and sounds for the emergency siren (can't wait to see what you'll create!)
[/list]
[b]AI & NPC Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the way NPCs and NPVs react to the police car with lights, emergency siren and lights & siren together
[*] Improved traffic behavior at intersections
[*] Added AI improvements which make the AI more human-like: NPCs react to the police cars sirens and actions around them, if there are gunshots or taser being deployed (instead of chilling like nothing has happened at all and that is just a regular occurence in their neighborhood, just like an old lady throwing flower pots at you just because you've been a biiiit louder when gaming, smh)
[*] Changed the stopping distance between NPVs in traffic and on accident sites
[*] Added more functionality to NPCs feet making their walking more realistic
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the names of NPCs in Encounter reports to make it clearer what actions and NPCs caused loss or gain of the CP/SP (now you know who to blame)
[*] Improved the handbook, added categories to make it easier to search through the handbook entries
[*] Added warning pop-up messages after player changes the spawn density/range settings
[*] Adjusted in-game credits (it's me!!)
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now arrest someone for fleeing
[/list]
[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvement of overall in-game performance
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjustment of NPC spawning range and density in multiplayer
[/list]
[b]Tutorials[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Tutorial "Radar-Gun" which explains how to use the Radar Gun
[*] Added new Tutorial "Stun Gun" which explains when and how to deploy a taser
[*] Added new Tutorial "Flashlight" which explains how to turn on your flashlight
[*] Added new Tutorial "Driving with a broken Windshield" which explains when a driver should be detained for their broken windshield
[*] Added new Tutorial "Open Patrol" which explains the basics of playing an open patrol shift
[*] Added new Tutorial "High Crime Area" which explains to the player what is a high crime area in the game
[*] Added new Tutorial "Fleeing" that explains what should be done, if an NPC is fleeing
[*] Adjusted Gun tutorial text to make it clearer when it is allowed to use your gun during the shift
[/list]
[b]Happy Birthday![/b]
[list]
[*] Decorated the precincts to celebrate our upcoming anniversary!
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[i]GAMEPLAY[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a player would get stuck in a fleeing dialogue
[*] Fixed issues where SP could get farmed
[*] Fixed an issue for there being no CP loss after tasing an injured NPC
[*] Fixed issue where a player could tase a driver NPC
[*] Fixed an issue where Traffic Stop parking slots would not get properly filled by the NPVs
[*] Fixed issue where a player would not be able to give orders to a detained NPC
[/list]
[i]MULTIPLAYER[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where in Multiplayer the second player would see NPC outside of their vehicle
[*] Fixed Multiplayer issue in which the second player was not able to interact with NPCs
[*] Fixed an issue where there would be almost no NPCs during a Multiplayer session
[*] Fixed patrol vehicles animations when both players interacted with it at the same time
[/list]
[i]NPCs[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with floating NPCs
[*] Fixed an issue where there were no NPCs in the holding cells
[*] Fixed NPCs clipping into vehicles in accidents after they would step out of their vehicle
[/list]
[i]PATROL CAR & TRAFFIC CARS[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Utility vehicle could get damaged too much visually
[*] Fixed NPV clipping and floating issues in accidents
[*] Fixed a bug when a police officer crashed inside a vehicle in accident it would add more evidence (technically, that's realistic, but...)
[*] Fixed issues where the cars number plates would float
[*] Fixed NPVs reacting to the Emergency Siren while they were driving the opposite direction
[*] Fixed NPV teleporting after using the police ladle
[/list]
[i]WORLD & GRAPHICS[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed the ability to clip into various objects after opening the trunk of a police car
[*] Fixed issues where objects at accident sites would be fallen over unnaturally
[*] Fixed Emergency Lights not showing properly on low & medium video settings
[*] Fixed issues where certain precinct walls had gaps
[/list]
[i]UI[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where video settings would not get saved
[*] Fixed a UI overlap when a player would receive "Your First Shift" tutorial
[*] Fixed tutorials not opening their correct handbook page after pressing "H"
[*] Fixed an issue where video settings would not get applied after pressing "F" button
[*] Fixed multiple text overlaps in UI
[*] Fixed various translation issues
[/list]
[i]CONTROLS[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed loss of input after attempting to give directions to the NPCs
[/list]
[i]MISCELLANEOUS[/i]
[list]

[/list]
[i]CRASHES[/i]

[*] Fixed various other crashes (thank you, everyone!)

notes.title: AI Improvements: Here's how much will change with The Traffic Management Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/3e18da3da01f96b7218706c6dfe2601636389288.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
with the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/3203758876958364672][b]Traffic Management Update[/b][/url] (the beta starts next week!), we're introducing a lot of AI Improvements with a focus on the overall behavior of NPVs (Non-Player-Vehicles).

As the team has put a lot of work into the AI Improvements, we want to show off some of the changes we made over the last few months. In short: NPVs will now react a lot smarter to sirens, they approach intersections better and their lane switching behavior is more advanced.

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=841vnOvQ6OA;full][/previewyoutube]
In this video, you can see that we've blocked off the lane on the very left with one of our brand-new road barriers. The NPVs will understand it as a way to turn back and accept the need to take another route. In turn, this allows you to better work on, for example, accident sites, and resolve traffic jams.

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=fCG6x-G6lYY;full][/previewyoutube]
In this video, you can see how NPVs begin to drive slower once you have your blue lights turned on. They begin to drive faster once you turn them off again. A nice side effect: On wider streets, you can easier drive through the gaps between cars and react to their movements.

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=IBSvw4EEEBc;full][/previewyoutube]
NPVs now react a lot faster to your blipping and find a parking spot immediately. No need to drive around 100 blocks with them (and that always felt like an eternity).

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=G6FHQoFudMM;full][/previewyoutube]
Here, you can see how far intersections are being blocked by your siren. They stand still until you have driven past them, which makes it easier to drive to the location you are required at.

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=h-Os7WxLJg4;full][/previewyoutube]
Speaking of intersections: NPVs which are very close to an intersection will not react directly to your siren and will try to make space so that you have a wider gap to drive through.

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=rbVo9YiyLe0;full][/previewyoutube]
They also clear the intersection if you have your siren enabled continuously, making sure that you have all the time and space in the world to reach your destination.

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=JtW6Qq5j1cI;full][/previewyoutube]
If you disable the siren but keep the blue lights shining, the cars will begin to traverse the intersection.

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=z444xYM9OM0;full][/previewyoutube]
Let's get back to your road barriers: In this video, you can see how smooth NPVs react to blocked-off lanes. They spot the barrier and immediately move to a different lane.

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=jBP3WhTm4a4;full][/previewyoutube]
It's not just barriers, though! NPVs also react to cones and will switch to a different lane - if a different lane is available. Otherwise, they would turn around and find a different route.

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=h8NLiiOkm2k;full][/previewyoutube]
You're at full speed, crossing an intersection with sirens and blue lights enabled? Then, NPVs crossing an intersection as well will brake fast so that you won't crash into them.

[hr][/hr][previewyoutube=sx7okvRyRjU;full][/previewyoutube]
NPVs are smart enough not to brake and halt should you drive in a different direction than them, and will continue to drive their desired route.

[h2]What's inside The Traffic Management Update?[/h2]

The Traffic Management Update will release in Open Beta on May 31, 2022. If you want to learn more about everything that's inside, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/997010/view/3203758876958364672]check out our recent blog post[/url]!

notes.title: The Beta for The Traffic Management Update is starting on May 31!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/c3329eed8b8660c700950fd673f1f685b7e76b64.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Fellow officers,[/h3][/i]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/997010/Police_Simulator_Patrol_Officers/]Police Simulator: Patrol Officers[/url] is growing further and further each month – and after experiencing all the heights, it's now time to go back to the ground, straight to the streets of Brighton. 

[b]Welcome to The Traffic Management Update, coming to you in beta on May 31 – with the full update launching on June 28![/b]

[h2]Get control over Traffic and NPCs![/h2]

As a patrol officer of the Brighton Police Department, one of the most important parts of your everyday shift concerns the safety of each driver and pedestrian.

Our arsenal chefs have worked tirelessly to stack up your equipment to ensure your success in fulfilling this duty. Now, we can present the fruits of their labor: We're pleased to announce that you can now find cones and barriers inside your trunk, helping you to close off and secure accident sites, entire streets or individual lanes!

[i]YOU SHALL NOT PASS![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/e9287dfb4dfa4cb30eacf60304c0210e4d3a5e38.jpg[/img]

[h2]Just the right signals[/h2]

Physical barriers are fine - but why not issue verbal & gestural commands as well? With The Traffic Management Update, you receive a variety of options to use your [i]magical[/i] hands!

You can now order...
[list]
[*] NPCs to stop and wait
[*] NPCs to walk to a different location and wait there
[*] NPCs to not use the sidewalk at all
[*] NPCs to turn around and use a different route
[*] NPVs to wait
[*] NPVs to turn around and use a different route
[/list][b]Show them who's in charge![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/98036cc2a8ae3f69d36f44341f6b5855cf6ed6dd.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Sound of Sirens[/h2]

With [url=https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/997010/announcements/detail/3208259928996928218][b]The Holding Cells Update[/b][/url], we've introduced our very first modding options - and wow, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/997010/workshop/]your creations[/url] are absolutely amazing! My entire hard drive has been flooded with your mods as I've downloaded and installed every single one of them.

Those of you who hoped for even more ways to mod the game, I got some good news for you! ELS Modding is now finally available and we've made it [i]highly[/i] customizable.

First: You can adjust the ELS for both sirens and blipping. Second: You can adjust ALL lights on all patrol cars, including their frequency, color, and brightness. Third: You can also change the sounds.

By the way, you can already start working on your ELS mods! We've released a comprehensive guide and updated the official mod kit to get you started:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2808924041

[h2]Huge AI Improvements[/h2]

Together with the new traffic control features, we're also shipping a bunch of AI improvements. NPVs will now react a lot smarter to sirens, they approach intersections better, their lane switching behavior is more advanced – and NPCs behave more believable near patrol vehicles.

In addition, you can now customize the spawn/despawn radius of NPVs and NPCs as well as the general density of traffic and pedestrians.

[h2]Bug fixes, performance improvements & other new features[/h2]

Once again, the team put a huge focus on fixing a bunch of longstanding bugs and bringing the game up to an even higher standard (the sky is the limit!).

We also resolved a bunch of crashes, improved performance plus framerates across the board... and fleeing has become an arrest reason!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39820260/b5441d972875e4cf8c882d03d52a49794c9f91d1.jpg[/img]

[h2]What else?[/h2]

That's it for now! Please look forward to the start of the beta next week (NEXT WEEK, YES, NEXT WEEK!) and share your thoughts with us in the comments down below :)
